title: Expose fused T16 one-block encoder to pure AVX2
description: Current d39c77d frozen prevalidated exact-main ABBA shows credible GF8 1 KiB encode deficits for balanced K=9..15 (roughly 2.5-7.3%) while K16 is already a small win. Pure AVX2 does not expose the existing side-16 fused one-block callback: it is compiled/routed only for the AVX-512 variant, so the mature path performs extra inverse/forward memory passes. Prototype a pure-AVX2 side-16 callback and, only if useful, exact shortened/punctured K=9..15 schedules.
design: First compile the existing callback unchanged for pure AVX2 and use same-source route controls to measure K15/16,R15/16 at 1 KiB. Then specialize zero input lanes and omit punctured output stores for K=9..15 only if the generic callback is promising. Keep the implementation in an isolated AVX2 translation unit or otherwise prove code-layout stability; no EVEX. Do not reopen wrapper-only approaches already rejected by .47.12/.43.17.
acceptance_criteria: Independent direct-generator and legacy parity pass for every selected shape; packed/unaligned/sparse/alias/failure-atomic behavior unchanged; pure AVX2 object has no EVEX/ZMM/opmask; focused Release and bounded ASan/UBSan pass. Frozen exact-main and same-source ABBA cover K=9..16/R=K/B=1024 plus B=1023/1025 and K/R neighbors. Promote only cells with credible improvement, no unexplained neighboring regression over 2%, and acceptable code size; otherwise retain a documented negative result.
notes:

Conservative production selector is 512..2048 bytes inclusive, 64-byte multiples, pure AVX2/native layout only. Direct-generator and legacy parity tests cover K9..16 at 512/1024/2048, ordinary/batch/reusable binding, unaligned packed buffers, sparse/nonpacked/ragged/neighbor exclusions, and 8-thread shared-codec execution. description: Current-source pure-AVX2 pinned ABBA at K=192/200/224,R=32,B=64,loss=32 proves reusable native-high tiled execution is 25-31 percent slower than exact Leopard1 main while B=256 is already 9-16 percent faster and one-loss is 4.1-5.7x faster. An every-K same-binary directional screen then showed the existing regular Algorithm 5 schedule beats stored exact-pruned schedules for every K=33..224 at R=L=32: 1.47x geometric mean at B64, 1.32x at B128, 1.26x at B192, 1.21x at B256, and 1.07x at B1024. Promote a byte-aware execution choice without changing wire arithmetic or plan ownership.
design: For native-layout legacy-high GF8 on the actual AVX2 Ops table, T=R=L=32, parent 128 or 256, K=33..224, flags zero, the tiled specialized path, and a complete execution pass of 64..512 bytes, pass no exact input/output schedules to the existing Algorithm 5 implementation. Keep immutable schedules in reusable plans because the same plan may later execute a larger shard where pruning wins. Reusable forced codecs remain exact-pruned controls. Preserve translated Algorithm 4, GF16, other backends, partial loss, punctured R<32, materialized/generic paths, larger passes, scratch geometry, and wire data unchanged. Ragged public tails are zero-padded 64-byte passes; public sizes through 575 may therefore bypass while 576 is pruned and 577 is mixed.
acceptance_criteria: Direct-algebra/generic/mature differential tests cover K around 128/160/192/200/224, diverse maximum-loss coordinate sets, guards, unaligned buffers, exact scratch, reusable/one-shot/batch/shared-plan paths, and forced fallback. Release plus Clang ASan/UBSan pass. Frozen same-executable ABBA lower CI95 is at least 1.05 for selected cells, exact-main ratio is at least 1.0, no neighboring regression exceeds 2 percent, binary provenance and zero-EVEX are verified, and negative results are retained if the terminal does not pay.

description: Current GF8 balanced/equal-rounded maximum-loss LOW/translated decode initializes a zero P-shard accumulator, differentiates zero, then multiply-adds the first live parity block. Derive and prototype selecting the first live block as the accumulator with its locator/block factor folded into scaling, eliminating the zero fill, zero derivative, and muladd-into-zero while preserving IT2026 Algorithm 4 arithmetic and wire behavior.
design: Start with scalar/direct-oracle equivalence, then AVX2 materialized and tiled paths. Keep generic/native-high controls. Gate only exact patterns whose first systematic block is wholly erased and whose later input block is live; fall back otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Exhaustive/small-field and GF8 differential tests prove identical recovery for balanced full loss and neighboring mixed patterns; materialized/tiled paths match; pinned pure-AVX2 same-source and exact-main ABBA at K=32,95,128 and 64/256/1024-byte shards shows a credible target gain with no unexplained neighboring regression over 2%; focused Release and ASan/UBSan pass; retain a negative result if the memory-pass saving does not pay.
notes:
2026-08-02 candidate implemented for GF8/GF16 materialized and tiled Algorithm 4: when block zero is empty, seed the accumulator from the first live later block and fold its nonzero block factor into locator-log scaling. This removes zero fill, zero derivative, and one weighted reduction pass. Focused GCC Release gates passed: low acceptance variants=10/plan_exec=40/one_shot=10, high-low duality decode_cases=1330/restored=29330, and schedule differential work_slots=4326/concurrent=128. Clang 18 ASan+UBSan passed the same three tests after removing an incompatible virtual-memory ulimit; quarantine was capped at 16 MiB. Independent static review found no correctness or safety issue. Targeted tests include GF8/GF16, materialized/tiled, compact tails, seed block 2, and another live block 3. Directional frozen effective-AVX2 screen: 540 strict-verified JSONs; full-loss median gain 1.317x over pre-change and 1.601x over exact main at K=32/95/128 and 64/256/1024B; every full-loss cell wins. Production AUTO R-1/R/2 paths were neutral versus pre-change but remain 1.155x-4.569x slower than main. Committed summary staged at experiments/leopard2/decoder_dispatch/results/empty_first_block_seed_amd_9950x3d_20260802.json. Strict authoritative v11 ABBA remains before closure because v10 isolation rejects the long immutable-input snapshot interval.
Implementation/evidence commit: 9d8dcda (Optimize balanced full-loss low decode). Bead remains in progress solely for the versioned authoritative short-isolation ABBA gate tracked by leopard-79h.16.2.2.1; code correctness and directional promotion evidence are complete.
close_reason: Empty-first-block Algorithm 4 optimization passes correctness/sanitizers and final frozen exact-main ABBA in all target and neighbor cells.

title: Close GF8 AVX2 R=1 small-shard reductions
description: Fresh current-source all-K diagnostics and prior isolated cells show that legacy-high GF8 R=1 remains slower than exact Leopard main at 64 and 256 bytes across most K, and around the 1 KiB crossover for many K. Attribute and optimize only existing wire-identical XOR paths: K2 terminal, K4 dense, K3 fused-final, and K>=8 coarse reduction. Keep K1 separate unless a candidate is independently justified.
design: First add one setup-time diagnostic mode captured immutably in codecs so candidate/control can be the same inode. Screen existing AVX2 bodies without changing arithmetic: exact B64/256/1024 for K2/K3/K4 and exact B64/256 for K>=8. Use 64/256/1024, byte neighbors, K boundaries, three missing positions, encode/public one-shot/reused-plan metrics. Isolate promotion evidence on one physical core with sibling idle; exact-main binary a43d7f... remains the external baseline. Preserve scalar/SSSE3/GFNI/AVX512 routes, scratch semantics, validation, aliasing, and arbitrary tails.
acceptance_criteria: Corrected self-describing 765-cell discovery artifact committed; same-inode selector A/B establishes target improvements; exact-main isolated MAAM/AMMA covers K2/3/4 plus K8/32/128/255 at target sizes and missing first/middle/last; digest identity, path attestation, immutable hashes, pure AVX2, Release and ASan/UBSan r1 tests pass. Promote only >=5% credible target wins with no unexplained >2% neighbor regression; retain negative results and leave unqualified selectors unchanged.
notes:

Mode1 selects existing K2 terminal at B64/256/1024, K3 fused-final at those sizes, K4 dense at those sizes, and K>=8 mature coarse at B64/256. Exact route introspection and benchmark schema v12 added. Initial build typo (target name) failed before compile; first compile then exposed missing Leopard2Direct.h test include, fixed before commit. Added default-off provenance-checked pure-AVX2 exact-main adapter because the historical a43d7f binary lacked a complete CMake closure and native rebuild emitted EVEX. New exact-main e252aa2 has zero EVEX and 2529 YMM operands; candidate 0e6143 has zero EVEX and 17559 YMM operands. title: Close GF8 K7 R4 1024-byte encode gap
description: The last source-bound exact-main checkpoint measured Leopard2/main at 1/0.918321 for GF8 legacy-high K=7,R=4,B=1024, about 8.9% slower than exact Leopard main. Reconfirm on current HEAD with the allocation-neutral shared-inode methodology, then screen an exact K7/R4/B1024 extension of the existing packed T=4 terminal. K7/R4/B512 already showed 1.198x over exact main, so reuse the proven backend body rather than adding a kernel.
design: First run a frozen current-HEAD baseline versus exact main. If the gap remains, widen only the exact K7/R4/B1024 selector, keep K7/R3 and K5/K6/K8 B1024 unchanged, and use the runtime T4 family selector or a narrowly scoped symmetric diagnostic control for attribution. Avoid a contiguous K range that silently selects unmeasured shapes.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned clean-source shared-inode/equal-path/equal-allocation ABBA covers K7/R4/B1024 target against same-source fallback and exact main. Require target CI95 lower bound >=1.05 for both contrasts; retain K7/R4/B512 and K4/K8 B1024 gates; K7/R3 B1024, K6/R4 B1024, K7 B1023/B1025/B2048 remain same-path controls within 2%. Direct-RS and Leopard1 parity, aligned/unaligned ordinary and one-item batch, sparse/detached/alias/failure atomicity, Release, GCC/Clang strict, focused ASan/UBSan, no new backend body, and production executable growth <=256 bytes.
close_reason: Killed before implementation after a fresh locked current-source recheck disproved the stale gap. Exact-main/Leopard2 geomean 1.014038, median 1.015303, CI95 0.999097..1.029203 across 9 alternating rounds; hashes/digests stable, CPU14 active and sibling30 idle. No credible five-percent opportunity remains, so no selector or kernel change is justified. Negative evidence commit de6e250; raw artifact SHA c2a92b6e....

title: Make ABBA executable paths allocation-neutral
description: The K8/B1024 authoritative campaign exposed stable 22-122% timing differences in byte-identical same-path K5/K7 cells when candidate/control argv[0] path lengths differed. Equal-length copied paths collapse the ratios to approximately one. The benchmark process heap layout is sensitive to argument allocation, so asymmetric executable paths invalidate comparisons.
design: Add a fail-closed optional equal-executable-path-length gate to the hardened ABBA base, enable it for K8/B1024, freeze all three binaries under equal-length paths, and retain the rejected campaign as diagnostic evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Runner rejects unequal candidate/control/main executable path lengths before timing; deterministic tests cover the gate; equal-path authoritative rerun has same-path controls within 2%, all provenance/isolation gates pass, and results document the invalid predecessor.
close_reason: Fixed by a054b0c, 2cae8a7, 38aaf12, and e828e09. Final shared-inode candidate/control used equal 62-character executable paths and equal-count/equal-length mode arguments; all 46x9 cell-rounds passed provenance and digest checks. Same-path K<8 controls ranged 0.984792..1.010246 and K8/B2048 controls 0.995140..0.998159, within the predeclared 2% band. Evidence: checkpoint 644362f, raw SHA 6e170ed2..., summary SHA ff0a5d58.... Rejected separate-ELF and asymmetric-argv campaigns are documented.

title: Close unselected GF8 T4 K8 and 512-byte gaps
description: The clean source-attested 76d0cdd 9-round ordinary-call matrix shows all 26 promoted T4 cells beat exact main, but all 12 immediately unselected neighbors remain slower. K8/R3-R4 at 64/256 bytes has exact-main/candidate ratios 0.4730-0.6310; K4..7/R3-R4 at 512 bytes has ratios 0.7176-0.9779. Extend the packed T4 setup/terminal or implement a safer shape-specific alternative without perturbing selected cells.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned clean-source same-text control and exact-main ABBA covers the 12 discovered neighbor cells plus all 26 existing selected cells as regression gates. Require bit-identical legacy/direct-oracle parity, fallback and alias safety, credible target gains, no unexplained regression over 2 percent, bounded code growth, Release, strict GCC/Clang, and focused ASan+UBSan.
notes:
2026-08-02 read-only ranking after T4/K8 promotions: (1) lowest-risk extend existing packed T4 terminal eligibility to B=512 for K4..7/R3..4; kernels, validator, scratch, unaligned/public/batch routes already support it, and required gains range about 1.02x-1.39x versus current. (2) For K8/R3-4 B64/128/256, compare a packed validator feeding mature high_encode_small against a generated/register-resident prepared T4 circuit; prepared variant removes intermediate four-row accumulator traffic and may meet the required ~2.1x B64/~1.59x B256 gains. Keep exact packed eligibility; do not globally enable K8 sub_2k register routing. (3) only after ordinary K8 wins, evaluate reusable multi-item K8 binding. Predicates cannot collide with K8/R8 T8 terminal.
2026-08-02 implementation audit: parallel B512 and K8 terminals are structurally orthogonal, but their shared byte predicate must explicitly keep B512 to K=4..7 so merging does not silently select unmeasured K8/B512. A short pinned non-authoritative exact-main screen established K8/R3-R4/B128 as a target too: current Leopard2 measured about 0.068-0.070 us versus main about 0.0358-0.0370 us, so the K8 candidate and final campaign should cover exact B64/B128/B256. K8 remains excluded from global sub-2-KiB high_encode_small routing.

All 40 selected cells beat same-source control (geomean 1.8845x, min lower CI 1.2798) and exact Leopard main (geomean 1.2687x, min lower CI 1.0439). title: Close GF8 T=32 K64/K127 64-byte residual gaps
description: Clean 1f2b121 exact-main three-round ABBA at 64 bytes gives main/Leopard2=0.933649 [0.914067,0.953651] for K64/R32 and 0.940672 [0.929931,0.951537] for K127/R28, i.e. 7.11% and 6.31% slower. Prevalidated directional ratios are still 0.979369 and 0.985130, so both public setup and T=32 arithmetic/layout contribute. Attribute full-block versus near-full final-block IFFT accumulation, schedule setup, callback/code layout, and validation; implement only broadly safe wins.
acceptance_criteria: Clean pinned exact-main and same-source ABBA covers K=63,64,65,96,100,126,127,128 with R=28,31,32 at 64/256/1024 bytes plus prevalidated attribution. Preserve legacy parity and all alias/tail/backend contracts. Promote >=5% target gains or a simple broad improvement with no credible >2% neighbor loss; Release, independent oracle, strict GCC/Clang and focused ASan+UBSan pass; retain negative layout/kernel results.
notes:
2026-08-02 read-only trace at clean 1f2b121: GF8 high B64 K64/R32 and K127/R28 both use one aligned pass, empty sparse plan, 64 work pointers. K64 executes about 73 indirect arithmetic callbacks; K127 about 123. Highest-value candidate is a pure-AVX2 prepared radix-2 inverse range plus XOR-range: the prepared primitive already exists inside an AVX512-variant guard, and exposing it would collapse K64's final inverse layer from 32 to 2 calls and K127's from 64 to 4. Next candidates: setup-resolved T32/B64 binding executor; fuse last inverse accumulation with first forward radix4 (modeled 64 row-touch/4KiB saving); spill-free B64-only radix8; low-ceiling K127 partial-leaf mask. Avoid direct matrices, sparse scheduling, tiling, NT stores, and copy-elimination here because prior evidence or this layout rules them out. Prevalidated gaps are only 2.1%/1.5%, so gate each by exact-main and same-source ABBA.
2026-08-02 claimed after T4 implementation commit 76d0cdd while its final provenance matrix runs. Planned first candidate: pure-AVX2 prepared final-IFFT radix-2 range with XOR-accumulating sibling, high-callsite-only T=32/B64 selection, same-binary diagnostic attribution, startup KAT, exact legacy/direct-oracle tests, and code-section isolation.

acceptance_criteria: Under the isolated subreaper lease, every new direct/adopted child is retained by exact PID/starttime or equivalent race-free handle even when Popen never returns and the token was never applied; canary and leak-job KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit fault injections leave no process; cleanup remains bounded and never signals a pre-existing/unrelated child; normal and python -O tests pass.

title: Version current main/all-K evidence after replay and selector contract changes
description: The current main-comparison raw/manifest/failure v8 and all-K contract/manifest v4 identifiers predate the current closure-v2, effective-config-v3, proof-v3, canonical-plan-v2 contract. title: Contain and bound leak-job executor process trees
description: tools/leopard2_fuzz_campaign.py:_execute_leak_job still signals killpg(Popen.pid), performs an unbounded process.wait() after SIGKILL, and lacks opaque-token/session descendant containment. A setsid descendant can escape, a stuck leader can hang leak-run, and KeyboardInterrupt cleanup can block. Reuse the bounded canary/lab containment model and retained result-tree ownership.

title: Bound and clean LSAN canary process trees
description: tools/leopard2_fuzz_campaign.py:_run_lsan_canary_process performs an unbounded communicate() after SIGKILL, so a detached descendant retaining stdout/stderr can hang the campaign. Its post-reap killpg has a process-group reuse window, and BaseException during communicate can strand the canary. Use bounded capture/leader/descendant cleanup with stable process identity and unconditional teardown.
acceptance_criteria: A detached/session-changing canary descendant retaining captures cannot hang or survive timeout/KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit; no reused process group can be signaled; normal canary behavior remains correct; focused tests pass repeatedly under normal and optimized Python.

title: Version balanced compile schema for effective-config v3

A coherent v4-to-v2 downgrade drops the generalized one-loss selector while recomputing all self-rooted digests. Added coherent v4-to-v2 downgrade rejection and historical parser fixture. Evidence: py_compile/diff check and canonical-lock self-tests passed under normal Python and python -O.

title: Isolate replay outputs and freeze completed artifacts
description: Canonical replay validates output topology before execution and verifies it afterward, but the directory guard ignores final child-entry mutations. A transient symlink can be installed at an object/archive/executable/header/lock output, used by the tool to truncate an external victim, then replaced with an expected regular file before final verification.
acceptance_criteria: Every canonical replay writer operates only in a private, descriptor-addressed tmpfs; the parent namespace cannot observe or redirect stage outputs; after complete descendant reap, exact declared outputs are bounded, hashed, copied into distinct fully sealed memfds and provenance consumes only those immutable descriptors. Symlink/hardlink/rename/root-swap ABA for object, archive, executable, header and lock cannot modify an outside victim and rejects under normal/optimized Python; real replay passes.
notes: 2026-07-29 hardlink adversary proved precreated regular outputs are insufficient: GNU ar truncates an outside victim through an in-workspace hardlink before nlink/post checks can reject. Current repair isolates every writer in a private user+mount namespace tmpfs, redirects stage paths through a post-mount descriptor, copies completed artifacts to sealed memfd sinks only after writer-tree reap, and must pass lexical-root swap plus object/archive/executable/header/lock hardlink-victim tests.

title: Retain external lab JSON publication paths

title: Contain perf-counter preflight descendants
description: The lab perf preflight uses subprocess.run outside the signed session/token containment path. A content-addressed fake perf process can fork, setsid, exit nonzero, and leave an adopted daemon alive while the runner reports preflight_unavailable.

title: Preserve exact false-like CMake values in graph verifier
description: The Visual Studio/CMake structural verifier modeled the historical truthiness-based CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE default and collapsed STREQUAL comparisons against empty/zero into boolean truth. After production switched to an exact-empty default, OFF and other false-like nonempty values could be modeled as empty, and the mutation suite cascaded behind a stale attestation-module digest.
acceptance_criteria: Bind the current benchmark-attestation module digest; preserve symbolic STREQUAL identity for empty, zero, and false-like literals; model Release reachability as exact-empty or exact-Release; reject reverting the default guard to truthiness or OFF; mutation suite passes under normal Python and -O plus CMake sanitizer/architecture model tests.
notes:
Initial root reproduction: VS/CMake graph suite failed 428 mutation subcases from stale attestation digest, then 74 after digest refresh because the verifier still expected truthiness-based CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE default. Fix keeps all symbolic STREQUAL comparisons exact, models default Release as exact-empty OR exact-Release, and uses exact nonzero comparison for small-direct mode.
Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. title: Make all-K evidence directory acquisition interruption-safe

The child is not tracked by cleanup, and open_or_create clears local ownership before validation completes.

title: Close retained symlink descriptor on type-validation failure
description: git_capture._open_symlink closes its descriptor only for OSError. If open/fstat succeeds and post-read type validation raises GitCaptureError before ExitStack ownership transfer, the O_PATH descriptor leaks.
acceptance_criteria: Descriptor ownership is closed on every BaseException until transfer; deterministic regular-inode/readlink mismatch and injected errors leave fd counts unchanged under normal/python-O; full main-compare and integrated tests pass.
notes:

A line-trace KeyboardInterrupt between them leaks the committed-symlink descriptor. Registration must be atomic with acquisition/return.
Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Full main-compare suite passed 125/125 normal and -O; focused symlink ownership/line-trace interruption tests and independent review passed. Fix committed in 96c67cf.

title: Release pair-lease kernel socket when file validation raises

title: Reject shell injection through retained Make variables
description: The replay Make validator allowlists references such as ARGS, COLOR and CXX_FLAGS but does not semantically constrain their assignments. A retained assignment like ARGS = ; /tmp/unretained-helper expands an otherwise accepted recipe into an unretained command.
acceptance_criteria: Validate every recipe-reachable variable assignment and expansion, rejecting shell-control/command substitution and unretained-tool synthesis through direct, recursive and command-line variable forms; live Make bypasses plus normal/python-O provenance tests fail closed and a fresh real replay passes.

A direct plain -fplugin/-include/-B edit could execute while flags.make and compile_commands stayed canonical. The proof manifest also needs a digest/recomputable exact binding to candidate normalized argv rather than only format-checked compile_commands hashes and counts. Keep open until live recipe bypass and coherent proof mutation fail closed.
Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Provenance suite passed 71/71 on Python 3.12 and 3.13, normal and -O; exact flags/build.make/compile_commands binding and live shell-variable/direct-flag bypasses reject. The distinct whole selected-recipe inventory gap remains open as .15.4.1. Fix committed in 9cf3f67.

title: Handle process exit during pidfd signal identity recheck
description: LinuxThreadBackend.signal_process assumes process_identity is non-null after pidfd_open. If the target changes ownership/reuse identity in that interval, current.process_key raises AttributeError and can abort fail-closed restoration instead of reporting ThreadReused; ordinary exit still raises ThreadGone from procfs.
acceptance_criteria: Treat a null second identity as ThreadReused while retaining ordinary ThreadGone behavior; a deterministic mocked race test fails before and passes after; normal/python-O supervisor self-tests and integrated CTest pass.
notes: Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Affinity-supervisor normal and optimized self-tests both passed.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria met by committed fixes and recorded normal/-O, integrated Release, and independent audit evidence.

title: Make sealed benchmark descriptor ownership interruption-safe
description: run_child duplicates a sealed benchmark fd before entering its cleanup try, so BaseException in argument construction leaks it. ExecutableSnapshotOwner.close also pops ownership before close, losing a descriptor when close raises before taking effect.
acceptance_criteria: Every duplicated/owned descriptor has a retry-safe owner before the first interruption boundary; injected BaseException before command construction and before/after native close leaves no leak, stale/recycled close, or lost ownership; normal/python-O ResourceWarning-fatal tests and independent audit pass.
notes: 2026-07-29 resumed bug gate reproduced the same ownership defect in the authoritative all-K path: snapshot source/memfd transfer and close, retained pidfd transfer/close, and canonical benchmark-lock close can leak, retain stale fd numbers, close recycled fds, or wedge the campaign lock under BaseException. Fix with identity-bound ownership before the first transfer boundary and test close-before-effect/after-effect/recycle under normal and python-O.

title: Freeze timed launcher and dynamic runtime closure
description: The timed main comparison invokes mutable /usr/bin/taskset before the sealed benchmark memfd, while the dynamic loader and DSOs remain pathname-loaded. Before/after hashing permits same-UID A-B-A substitution during exec.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic launcher and user-writable-RPATH DSO A-B-A adversaries cannot execute B while evidence proves A; either seal/private-load the complete runtime closure or hold continuous mutation guards through child exit; bind the exact executed launcher, loader and DSO closure in raw/failure/manifest evidence and pass normal/python-O review.

title: Reject every non-canonical GNU Make dollar-reference form
description: The replay Make validator only consumes parenthesized/braced references. GNU Make single-character references such as $M pass validation and can synthesize gmake, selecting an unretained -f recipe.
acceptance_criteria: Consume and validate the complete dollar syntax of every retained Make line; allow only the exact canonical generated references, reject single-character, automatic, escaped, malformed and unmatched dollar forms; live bypass plus normal/python-O tests fail closed and a fresh real replay passes.
notes: Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Provenance suite passed 71/71 on Python 3.12 and 3.13, normal and -O; live dollar-form bypasses reject and compiler replay CTest passed. Fix committed in 9cf3f67.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria met by committed fixes and recorded normal/-O, integrated Release, and independent audit evidence.

title: Bind authoritative Python execution image and runtime prefix closure
description: Authoritative Python helpers distinguish the /proc/self/exe execution inode from argv[0] prefix discovery only incompletely, and do not bind normal stdlib/extension imports. A same-UID-writable prefix can change executed startup code after launcher snapshots. Record and validate execution-image and discovery-path identities separately and either retain the imported runtime closure or require a same-UID-immutable canonical prefix.
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative runners reject an unrelated/replaced discovery executable and same-UID-writable unbound stdlib; exact /proc/self/exe bytes remain the kernel-selected image; prefix discovery works under Python 3.12/3.13 with -I -S -B; path-swap, module-mutation, omission, normal/-O, and offline replay tests pass; non-authoritative self-tests remain portable.
notes: 2026-07-29 portability audit reproduced process_executable_identity(/usr/bin/false) returning the running Python inode/hash mislabeled with /usr/bin/false. Capture now binds a canonical retained path to /proc/self/exe; later verification revalidates the immutable executing inode so a post-capture pathname swap remains safe. Prefix discovery intentionally compares base-executable bytes rather than inode, preserving copied-interpreter execution. Tighten the retained-record canonical shape; broader stdlib/prefix closure remains open.

title: Bind the complete retained replay-recipe inventory
description: The v2 proof inventory digest is self-rooted: a coherent proof can omit an unrewritten flags.make or DependInfo.cmake, recompute count/bytes/digest, and still validate. Recursive-Make counts can also be inflated above the producer value. Bind the exact configured candidate path set and exact recursive count to an independently authenticated closure.
acceptance_criteria: Removing, adding, renaming, retyping, reordering, or coherently rehashing any retained recipe fails offline verification; exact producer recursive-Make count is enforced; historical schemas keep exact rules; real single/multi-config supported closures pass under normal and python -O.
notes:
2026-07-29 semantic compile binding now exact-checks each production object recipe, but the broader inventory remains self-rooted: a new standalone/phony recipe elsewhere in retained Make inputs can execute an arbitrary literal command unless the exact candidate-generated recipe graph is independently bound. Offline semantic compile_commands_sha256 is also only internally cross-equal to semantic_inputs and can be coherently replaced while candidate digests remain unchanged. Bind or remove every non-recomputable claim when completing this bead; no authoritative timing through replay until then.
2026-07-29 independent replay audit produced three safe executable reproducers. _validate_replay_make_include_closure accepted (1) a new prerequisite with an arbitrary literal helper recipe, (2) $(CMAKE_COMMAND) -E env invoking an unretained helper, and (3) a retained DependInfo.cmake with injected execute_process reached by cmake -E cmake_depends; each created a marker while canonical production object argv/artifacts could remain unchanged. Completion therefore requires exact selected target/prerequisite reachability, command-specific argv grammars (not an executable allowlist), and canonical semantic binding of every reachable executable .cmake input. No authoritative clean-replay timing is valid before this gate closes.
2026-07-29 current working-tree canonical replay implementation independently passed 88/88 under normal Python and python -O after exact recipe grammar, force-target, traversal, indirect-flag, output-topology, and offline-validation fixes. Final real path-with-spaces normal/all-K replay remains paused until the lab/selector bug gate freezes source state; no authoritative timing is permitted meanwhile.

title: Eliminate replay-recipe rewrite ABA interval
description: During immutable recipe transport, rewritten paths are replaced before the post-rewrite inotify guard is installed. A same-path A-B-A rename during that interval can evade final inode/hash checks. Maintain continuous parent/path event history across each intentional atomic replacement and distinguish only the exact expected transport events.
acceptance_criteria: No interval exists between capture and execution without an active pathname/parent event history for rewritten and unrewritten recipes; injected replace/rename A-B-A at every transition fails closed; intentional atomic transport and restoration remain accepted; bounded guard count, interruption cleanup, real CMake closure, normal and python -O tests pass.

title: Support Linux evidence primitives when Python omits os wrappers
description: A fresh CMake/CTest run selected /home/catid/.local/bin/python3.13, whose os module omits memfd_create, pidfd_open, and P_PIDFD even though libc/kernel support works. Provenance, crossover, main/high-copy, and small-direct runners fail before exercising their tests. Use validated Linux libc/syscall fallbacks and a canonical P_PIDFD value where the runtime wrapper is absent; do not weaken fail-closed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All affected runners and provenance tests pass under both /usr/bin/python3 and /home/catid/.local/bin/python3.13, including sealed execution, pidfd reaping, normal and python -O suites; unsupported kernels still fail closed; full CTest no longer depends on which compatible Python CMake selects.

title: Execute authoritative benchmark runners from sealed binaries under the canonical lock
description: Several decoder-dispatch and high-copy runners execute mutable benchmark pathnames and merely compare identities before/after, permitting undetected A-to-B-to-A execution. They also do not acquire/attest the canonical campaign lock internally.
acceptance_criteria: Each authoritative runner holds the canonical lock for build/correctness/timing scope, executes lane-owned immutable snapshots, records and revalidates exact source/binary identity, rejects substitution and split-lock attacks, and has normal/python-O adversarial tests; otherwise explicitly mark/retire it as non-authoritative.

title: Accept and strictly validate authoritative main-compare schema v8
description: The current main_compare runner emits raw/manifest schema v8, while the balanced promotion consumer accepts only v5-v7 and rejects every fresh authoritative campaign. Add exact v8 semantics without weakening historical replay or allowing downgrade/coercion.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh authentic v8 evidence passes; forged, downgraded, mixed-version, type-coerced, and stale configuration evidence fails under normal and python -O tests; historical supported schemas retain their exact validation rules.
notes:
2026-07-29 final adversarial audit reproduced a current-v8 open-world campaign object: a coherently resigned raw or failure bundle can add an arbitrary campaign claim while validate_raw/validate_failure accepts it. Enforce the exact producer campaign key set for v8 only and add raw/failure normal/-O mutations.
2026-07-29 final audit also reproduced open-world v8 reservation identities: coherently adding the same unversioned claim to reservation and every invocation before/after record is accepted. Enforce exact {path,sha256,payload,lock} through one success/failure helper.

title: Cryptographically bind retained Git tree inventories in main comparison evidence
description: main_compare/git_capture.py validates the root tree object but does not retain/parse subtree/blob objects or otherwise bind regular-file records and flattened ls-tree inventory to that tree. A forged regular record can be rehashed and accepted while the retained commit/root tree remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Offline proof validation reconstructs the complete tracked inventory from retained authenticated Git objects (or equivalently self-authenticating bytes), binds each regular/symlink record to its Git blob and root tree, rejects omitted/added/substituted/mode/type/subtree/object mutations under normal and python -O, and fresh dirty/clean captures pass.

title: Eliminate interruption-time descriptor ownership gaps in replay evidence
description: Independent BaseException injection reproduced raw-FD leaks or recycled-FD closes in directory tree acquisition, generated executable/replacement writes, retained directory cleanup, recipe transport cleanup and proc/pidfd mapping cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: All acquisitions have an owner before the first interruption boundary; cleanup retains retry state until close/restore is reconciled; post-close recycled descriptors are not closed; targeted BaseException injection tests and ResourceWarning-fatal normal/python-O suites pass; different-agent audit finds no remaining current replay-path ownership loss.
notes: Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Provenance suite passed 71/71 x4 with close-before/after-effect, recycled-FD and acquisition interruption cases; independent replay audit found no additional descriptor-ownership loss. Fix committed in 9cf3f67.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria met by committed fixes and recorded normal/-O, integrated Release, and independent audit evidence.

title: Reconcile direct-crossover publication after committed rename interruption
description: Independent audit reproduced rename_noreplace/rename_exchange completing in the kernel and then raising BaseException before caller state updates. The runner reports publication failure even though the destination changed and can leave a stage file holding prior bytes.
acceptance_criteria: After interruption at every rename commit boundary, inspect retained inode/name state and deterministically commit or roll back; never report failure with an unreconciled destination; preserve prior bytes on failed replacement; remove owned stages; normal/python-O and independent audit pass.

title: Make immutable replay v2 validation fully canonical and offline
description: Independent audit found strict validation accepted reordered prefix mappings, forged private-tool topology, arbitrary recipe records, no-op rewrites and relative replay roots; malformed list-valued roles/pass_fds could escape as TypeError.
acceptance_criteria: Bind canonical mapping order, private workspace topology, absolute roots, complete recipe inventory and changed digests; type-check before lookup/set/sort; every malformed or tampered proof fails as BuildProvenanceError under normal and python -O; a fresh proof validates after all historical descriptors close and without touching historical paths.

title: Retain complete replay recipe closure without exhausting inotify instances
description: The complete Unix Makefiles replay closure exceeded the per-user inotify-instance limit when each generated recipe held its own snapshot guard. The first bounded redesign also exposed that top-level Make triggers legitimate CMake regeneration and dependency Makefiles are sealed-tool-derived mutable outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Use a bounded number of shared guards; capture every pre-build code-bearing Make/CMake/link input; execute the exact Makefile2 target without top-level regeneration; distinguish sealed-tool-derived dependency outputs; reject post-capture mutation; pass a greater-than-128-recipe regression and a fresh byte-identical real replay without EMFILE or false mutation failure.

title: Capture small-direct source identity from one guarded immutable snapshot
description: Both new small-direct runners execute independent /usr/bin/git command series and read bound source/provenance modules through mutable paths. They can therefore mix status/files from source state A with HEAD/tree or helper code from state B during an A-B-A mutation while still accepting a supposedly coherent clean build identity.
acceptance_criteria: Retain and execute one exact sealed Git image; componentwise hold ordinary/worktree gitdir and commondir; guard HEAD/refs/index/config/objects and the tracked worktree; cryptographically cross-bind commit object/tree/ls-tree/index flags/status/submodules and exact helper/source bytes. Load provenance/configuration code from the same retained snapshot. Deterministic command-stream and real .git/source A-B-A adversaries fail in both ABBA and exhaustive runners under normal/python-O; clean detached/current/worktree/superproject cases pass; independent audit is clean.

title: Publish and consume the complete immutable replay transport
description: The hardened reproducible-build helper appends immutable_replay, but the small-direct ABBA consumer still requires the old exact nine-key proof and rejects every real capture. The proof also publishes only underlying tool images, omitting the seven sealed wrapper executables actually invoked and the C/C++ wrappers' injected -B prefix mappings, so the attestation does not describe the executed transport.
acceptance_criteria: Version and validate a complete proof schema that binds every actually executed sealed wrapper, underlying executable, injected argv/prefix mapping, recursive Make transport, and replay Git transport; update every consumer with strict current-schema validation and historical replay rules. Real transform/output/source captures pass; omitted/extra/reordered/substituted wrapper or injected-argument records fail under normal and python -O; independent audit and fresh byte-identical replay pass.
notes: 2026-07-29 independent audit confirmed three coupled defects. (1) verify_reproducible_candidate_build now appends immutable_replay while small-direct validate_reproducible_build_proof requires the old exact nine-key v1 shape, so every real capture fails. (2) published immutable_replay lists underlying tools but omits all seven sealed wrappers actually invoked and the C/C++ injected -B prefix mappings. (3) deterministic monkeypatch after wrapper write but before retained snapshot injected side effects into ar/cmake/cxx/make/ranlib wrappers; a real -j128 replay still reproduced all 14 objects/archive/executable and the marker recorded 69 injected executions, while all proof fields and 18 published non-replay-Git tool records matched normal. Artifacts /tmp/leopard2-provenance-audit-injected-wrapper.json and marker. Generate expected bytes in memory, require exact retained content before execution, publish normalized wrapper specs/sealed identities/prefix mappings/rewrite manifest, version proof and update strict consumers.

title: Make immutable executable descriptor ownership interruption-safe
description: _RetainedFileSnapshot.executable_descriptor stores the new memfd in self._executable_descriptor before final read/hash/reverification. A KeyboardInterrupt/BaseException then closes only the local descriptor while leaving the object claiming ownership of the closed fd, permitting later verification/double-close against a recycled descriptor.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer descriptor ownership to the object only after all validation succeeds, or atomically reset ownership before cleanup. BaseException injection at every write/seal/read/hash/verify boundary leaves no stale member and no FD leak/double-close, preserves primary plus cleanup diagnostics, and passes ResourceWarning-fatal normal/python-O tests and independent audit.
notes: Fresh GNU 13 Release build /tmp/leopard2-pre-resume-release-1785346131 passed 113/113 CTests in 423.22s at committed source content; git diff --check clean. Child ownership matrix and independent audit satisfy the retained executable ownership contract; broader recipe semantic closure remains separately tracked. Fix committed in 9cf3f67.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria met by committed fixes and recorded normal/-O, integrated Release, and independent audit evidence.

title: Capture main/all-K Git identities from guarded single snapshots
description: run_abba.git_identity and run_allk_gap.git_identity issue independent rev-parse/status/ls-tree/cat-file command series without retaining one Git executable/gitdir or guarding refs/index/worktree across the capture. The direct/provenance auditors reproduced the same construction accepting closure A mixed with commit/tree B. Main input_snapshot repeats this before/after invocations but each capture can be internally mixed.
acceptance_criteria: Use one exact retained Git executable and componentwise held ordinary/worktree gitdir per capture; guard refs/HEAD/index/config/objects and tracked worktree against mutation/ABA; cryptographically cross-bind commit object tree, ls-tree blobs, status/index flags, submodules, and source bytes. Main and all-K deterministic command-stream and actual .git A-B-A adversaries fail normal/python-O while real clean detached main/current candidate/superproject/worktree cases pass; independent audit is clean.
notes: 2026-07-29 root cross-runner audit confirmed the same independent-command-series construction in run_abba.git_identity and run_allk_gap.git_identity. Direct/provenance deterministic mixed-snapshot repro applies structurally; timing remains blocked until guarded capture is shared or equivalently implemented.

title: Execute main ABBA benchmarks from sealed immutable snapshots
description: run_abba input_snapshot hashes mutable benchmark paths before/after each invocation, but run_child executes those paths directly. The direct-runner audit proved an owner can overwrite the same inode A-to-B, execute B, and restore A before postvalidation while all path/inode/hash checks accept A. The canonical exact-main runner has the same construction unless wrapped by all-K.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot baseline and candidate bytes into MFD_ALLOW_SEALING memfds, require ELF/executable semantics, apply F_SEAL_WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL, inspect and execute the exact sealed descriptors through collision-safe inherited fd mappings, and bind snapshot SHA/size/seals to reproduced build closure and every invocation record. Deterministic same-inode A-B-A, pathname swap, fd collision, failed-copy/seal, and cleanup tests pass normal/python-O; standalone genuine smoke and independent audit pass.
notes:
2026-07-29 root cross-runner audit: main run_child builds command from specification baseline/candidate path, brackets only input_snapshot, and passes mutable pathname to run_process_bounded. All-K happens to wrap it with sealed memfds, but standalone canonical exact-main does not. Campaign publication is blocked until standalone main owns/binds sealed snapshots.
2026-07-29 implementation freeze c6a5735d/bb83fdaa pending independent audit: main runner schema v8 captures validated baseline/candidate ELF bytes into MFD_ALLOW_SEALING memfds, applies F_SEAL_WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL, binds exact snapshot SHA/size/mode plus ldd/runtime/build closure, executes retained high descriptors through collision-safe mappings while recording stable logical argv, and binds every invocation/raw/manifest/failure record. Deterministic same-inode A-B-A, path swap, fd collision, seal/copy/cleanup fault, evidence mutation and v7 replay tests pass. Suite 98/98 normal and 98/98 python -O, ResourceWarning fatal; py_compile/diff-check clean. Different-agent audit active; coherent Git capture remains separately open in .3.16.
2026-07-29 independent v8 audit finding (fix pending): validate_raw accepts a coherently re-signed current v8 raw after adding arbitrary top-level unversioned_claim or deleting required created_utc; public verify_campaign similarly returns success for a v8 manifest with an arbitrary top-level field and missing created_utc. Current-schema exact-key/required-field validation must be added with normal/-O adversaries before .15 can close. This is independent of known coherent-Git .3.16.
2026-07-29 independent v8 audit second/third findings (fix pending): _run_campaign_owned catches only Exception after snapshots are captured, so injected KeyboardInterrupt/BaseException at first cpu_stat_snapshot bypasses both snapshot_owner.close paths and leaves both sealed memfds live. Also current v8 failure input_specification accepts unknown keys; deleting a required key leaks raw KeyError instead of a bounded EvidenceError. Cleanup must cover BaseException while preserving primary+cleanup diagnostics; current schema must validate exact nested key sets and normalize validation failures. Add fd-count/BaseException and malformed current-schema regressions normal/-O.
2026-07-29 consolidated independent v8 audit REJECT (frozen c6a5735d/bb83fdaa): current raw/manifest/invocation validation is open-world. Re-signed v8 raw and public manifest accept arbitrary top-level claims and missing created_utc; invocation accepts arbitrary execution claim and missing started_utc. Require schema-specific exact keys and validated timestamps for raw, manifest, raw-info, invocation and retained-stream records, with public replay adversaries normal/-O. The same audit reproduced BaseException snapshot-owner leaks and non-exact failure input_specification; all four defects must be fixed and independently re-audited before timing. Known coherent-Git .3.16 remains separate.
2026-07-29 fix freeze after independent reject: exact current v8 raw/manifest/invocation/stream/raw-identity schemas with canonical UTC timestamps; exact 12-key failure input specification with EvidenceError-only rejection; child-fd ownership fixed across evidence traversal; snapshot cleanup BaseException-safe with diagnostic aggregation. Historical v7 preserved. Full suite 104/104 normal and 104/104 -O ResourceWarning-fatal, py_compile/diff-check pass. Frozen hashes run_abba 7acbf666..., tests 00b6186b.... Pending different-agent re-audit and known coherent Git .3.16.

title: Capture direct-runner source identity as one guarded Git snapshot
description: The direct crossover runner collects tracked Git closure/repository controls and HEAD/tree identity in independent command series without one retained Git executable/gitdir or mutation guard, and validate_source_state does not bind git.tree/head to the captured index/head-tree closure. A deterministic command-stream adversary mixed clean closure A with HEAD/tree B and source_identity(require_clean=True) accepted it.
acceptance_criteria: Retain one exact Git executable and ordinary/worktree gitdir metadata across the complete source capture; guard the gitdir/index/HEAD/refs and tracked worktree against mutation/ABA; derive and cross-bind commit, tree, staged closure, tracked blobs, submodules, and dirtiness from the same snapshot. Deterministic A-B-A and mixed-command-stream adversaries fail normal and python -O; real clean/dirty/superproject/submodule cases pass; independent audit is clean.
notes: 2026-07-29 independent audit reproduced clean acceptance of closure/head-tree A followed by HEAD/tree B under a deterministic command-stream substitution: resulting identity claimed B commit/tree while binding A blob closure. Direct campaigns remain blocked.

title: Bind balanced planner JSON publication to held output directories
description: plan_balanced_promotion.write_json validates the output parent by pathname, then reopens it via tempfile.mkstemp, os.link, and os.open. A deterministic intermediate-directory A-to-symlink substitution after resolve makes the function return success while publishing into an attacker-selected external tree; restoring the original can also make later path validation inspect different bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Create and traverse owned output roots component-by-component with no-follow held dirfds; stage, fsync, publish no-replace, revalidate, and read back through the retained exact parent/inode; require exact owner-only modes and safe cleanup. Deterministic intermediate/final symlink ABA, temp-inode substitution, destination collision, crash-stage, and stored-byte mutation tests pass under normal and python -O with ResourceWarning fatal, followed by independent audit.
notes: 2026-07-29 deterministic reproduction: monkeypatched tempfile.mkstemp after parent.resolve to rename trusted root and replace it with a symlink; write_json returned success, evil/out/result.json existed, and saved trusted/out/result.json did not. Bug gate blocks balanced evidence publication until fixed and independently reviewed.

title: Make private Git replay preserve benchmark configuration identity
description: Clean provenance replay replaces LEO2_BENCHMARK_GIT_EXECUTABLE with a private emulator, but that pathname contributes to the generated benchmark configuration hash and compiled source. A real tests-off replay rebuild succeeds then necessarily fails exact argv comparison because candidate and replay configuration tokens differ.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible replay uses a runner-controlled Git view without changing the algorithm/wire/build configuration identity being proved, or introduces an explicit normalized transport field that cannot hide semantic differences. A normal exact candidate/replay succeeds; changed Git semantics/path-dependent compiled behavior fails; normal and python-O tests plus fresh tests-off and tests-on replay pass.
notes: 2026-07-29 independently reproduced: private Git replay transport changes the generated benchmark configuration identity embedded in benchmark.cpp, so a real tests-off exact candidate/replay rebuild succeeds then necessarily fails argv equality. Fix is being implemented with .13-.17 under the pre-resume bug gate.

title: Execute direct benchmark from a retained frozen inode
description: The direct crossover runner validates a frozen executable pathname before launch and after exit but does not retain or execute the validated inode. An A-to-B-to-A directory swap can run a substituted binary and restore the original before postvalidation, which was independently reproduced.
acceptance_criteria: Open and validate the artifact plus every parent through held no-follow descriptors, retain the exact executable inode for the job lifetime, and execute that inode (for example a safely inherited /proc/self/fd handle or equivalent) through taskset. Revalidate inode/hash/source identity after exit. Deterministic A-to-B-to-A substitution tests prove B never executes; normal and python-O suites pass.
notes:
2026-07-29 critical independent repro: exact held 0555 executable inode was overwritten in-place A->same-length B, /proc/self/fd/199 executed B, then bytes restored A before post-read; command returned B while pre/post held inode/mode/hash all reported A. Authoritative execution must copy validated bytes into a kernel-enforced immutable executable object (e.g. MFD_ALLOW_SEALING plus F_SEAL_WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL, executed through inherited procfd), bind sealed bytes/hash/identity, and test in-place A-B-A at exec.
2026-07-29 independent final audit: sealed benchmark/Git execution fixed A-B-A for those payloads, but authoritative command closure remains incomplete. Child argv still prepends path-executed /usr/bin/taskset; owner/supervisor re-exec uses mutable sys.executable and __file__; controlled CMake/build tools execute mutable paths. Same-inode A-B-A can execute B and restore A around existing hashes. Seal/bind these executables (including loader/interpreter semantics where relevant) or explicitly narrow/version the threat claim before promotion.

title: Bind and always publish main-ABBA failure records
description: The failure path uses lexical failure_path.exists(); any symlink, FIFO, stale file or hostile entry suppresses held-dirfd publication, while validation checks only the in-memory record and inventory excludes failure.json.
acceptance_criteria: Always publish failure.json through the held EvidenceDirectory using exclusive crash-atomic semantics; any preexisting entry fails as an invariant violation. Snapshot, parse, and compare the exact stored bytes and include their identity in inventory. Symlink/FIFO/hardlink/stale-name and stored-byte mutation tests pass normal and python-O.
notes: 2026-07-29 implementation complete pending independent audit: failure.json is always exclusively crash-atomically published via the held evidence dirfd, then exact stored bytes are re-snapshotted, parsed, compared and included in semantic/signature/inventory validation. Main runner suite 90/90 normal and 90/90 python-O.

title: Retain pidfds through main-ABBA process-tree cleanup
description: Main run_abba stores only PID plus /proc starttime and opens pidfds only when signaling; it may reap the leader before descendant cleanup. Linux starttime is jiffy-granularity, so same-tick numeric PID reuse can pass the comparison and target an unrelated process.
acceptance_criteria: Retain each leader/discovered process with before-pidfd_open-after identity validation, preserve pidfds until quiescent cleanup completes, use pidfd-only signal/wait/reap, and defer leader reap until descendant discovery is quiescent. Deterministic same-starttime PID-reuse, retained-pipe, post-Popen fault and descriptor-leak tests pass normal and python-O with ResourceWarning fatal.
notes: 2026-07-29 second implementation pass complete pending independent re-audit: snapshots hold no-follow proc dir dev+ino and all keys/normal/emergency paths use pid,starttime,proc dev+ino; historical lifetimes for reused numeric PID coexist and stale lifetimes cannot seed traversal. Held-dir rebound plus same/different-jiffy reuse tests pass. Main suite 94/94 normal and 94/94 python-O, ResourceWarning-fatal; pycompile/diff clean.

title: Reject permissive main-ABBA evidence roots and files on replay
description: EvidenceDirectory.open_existing and snapshot accept replay roots with mode 0777 and evidence files with mode 0666 because existing-root validation is not owner-only and inventory identity omits exact permission bits. Untrusted peers can mutate evidence while it is being authenticated.
acceptance_criteria: Existing and fresh evidence require exact owner-only directory/file modes (0700/0600) throughout held-inode snapshot and inventory validation; mode, UID/GID/link count and inode identity are bound and revalidated before/after every read/publication. Adversarial permissive-root/file, chmod-during-read, owner/link/inode replacement and normal/python-O tests fail closed without accepting partial evidence.
notes:
2026-07-29 implementation complete pending independent audit: current schema v7 requires exact 0700 roots/nested directories and 0600 evidence files, held inode/mode/uid/gid/nlink proof and re-snapshot validation. Explicit historical v1-v6 replay retains its versioned legacy mode policy. Main runner suite 90/90 normal and 90/90 python-O.
2026-07-29 independent v8 audit finding (fix pending): EvidenceDirectory._open_parent opens a child dirfd and then validates it, but its rejection path closes only the previous parent. Replaying an exact owner evidence root with nested directory chmod 0755 raises as intended yet leaks the rejected child fd (repeatable /proc/self/fd +1); _open_absolute_directory/create_new have the same open-before-validation pattern to audit. Close every newly opened descriptor on every validation exception and add repeated malformed-tree ResourceWarning/fd-count tests normal/-O.
2026-07-29 consolidated audit exact repro: chmod a nested evidence directory 0755 then snapshot nested/value raises EvidenceError but leaks one live fd per attempt. _open_parent, _open_absolute_directory, and create_new all require explicit ownership transfer/close of newly opened child on every validation exception; add repeated fd-count regressions normal/-O.

title: Make main ABBA evidence publication crash-atomic and resumable
description: EvidenceDirectory.write_exclusive creates and writes the final O_EXCL inode directly. ENOSPC, I/O failure, interruption, or process death after creation leaves a partial final file; later resume correctly refuses replacement but cannot recover without manual deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Write each payload to an owner-only same-directory temporary O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW inode, complete and fsync/revalidate it, then atomically publish without replacing an existing final name (Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE or an equivalently crash-safe primitive), fsync the directory, and revalidate final inode/bytes/path. Pre-publication write failure leaves no final file and retry succeeds; existing final is never replaced; crash/failure-stage, ENOSPC/short-write, symlink/race and normal/-O resumability tests pass without orphan ambiguity.
notes: 2026-07-29 second implementation pass complete pending independent re-audit: rollback tracks flock and independently attempts temp unlink, staged-fd close, unlock and parent close while preserving primary+rollback errors. ENOSPC plus injected unlink/fstat/fsync faults report exact diagnostics, leak zero FDs, and retry without deadlock. Main suite 94/94 normal and 94/94 python-O, ResourceWarning-fatal; py_compile/diff clean.

title: Reject contradictory and stronger ISA flags in provenance closure
description: _validate_compile_flags checks for a few required/forbidden tokens but accepts globally stronger -march values and later contradictory flags such as -mno-avx2, -mno-gfni, or -mno-ssse3, so the claimed portable/pure-AVX2 profile need not match effective compiler semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Validate an exact ordered/effective target-option policy for portable, SSSE3, AVX2 and GFNI translation units; reject -march/-mcpu/-mtune target escalation, contradictory positive/negative ISA options, duplicates and driver-option forms that alter the floor. Deterministic mutations cover orderings; canonical GCC/Clang builds and normal/-O provenance tests pass.
notes: Independent reproduction accepts -specs=/tmp/..., -B/tmp/..., and -fplugin=/tmp/... as portable-core; -B may also redirect supposedly attested subtools because lookup ignores compile argv. Exact compile argv closure must reject all driver/toolchain/plugin/specs/sysroot/wrapper/response escapes in addition to every non-whitelisted -m*/target switch. Canonical GCC/Clang recipes remain accepted.

title: Freeze the exact source tree consumed by provenance replay
description: Candidate capture and clean replay snapshot sources only outside compilation. A same-UID attacker can compile substituted source B, restore A before provenance capture, repeat B during clean replay, then restore A; matching objects are falsely attributed to A.
acceptance_criteria: Every source and generated build input consumed by candidate/replay is compiled from a runner-owned immutable tree/snapshot or otherwise cryptographically bracketed without ABA gaps. Source-root/final-file swaps during candidate and clean builds are rejected; A-to-B-to-A adversaries cannot produce evidence attributed to A; normal/-O and fresh replay pass.
notes:
2026-07-29 independent real temp-repo reproduction: source capture began/ended with commit A but recorded commit B while tracked bytes remained A by swapping .git for both Git probes. add_directory_path(source) deliberately ignores child names, and /usr/bin/git is retained only per individual probe. Bind and mutation-guard the actual .git path/gitdir and one Git executable across the full capture, including worktrees/submodules as supported.
2026-07-29 final adversarial audit found input_snapshot hashes build source records before the authenticated Git capture without one cross-binding guard. A source A/B/A interval can make build provenance describe B while Git closure proves A. Cross-bind every required compile source SHA/blob to the retained Git tree under one continuous guard before accepting authoritative main evidence.
2026-07-29 Git object audit reproduced an impossible D/F duplicate basename accepted by _parse_tree_object because uniqueness compares flattened foo versus foo/. Reject duplicate raw entry names before type suffixing and add an offline Merkle regression.

title: Execute clean-replay tools through immutable retained identities
description: verify_reproducible_candidate_build retains compiler/archiver/ranlib descriptors but nested CMake configure/build still resolves their cached pathnames. A same-UID A-to-B-to-A directory swap can make the clean build use B while final retained-path verification accepts restored A.
acceptance_criteria: Clean replay invokes compiler, C++ compiler, archiver and ranlib through runner-owned immutable copies or descriptors inherited through the complete configure/build process; no transient pathname substitution can affect execution. Deterministic A-to-B-to-A parent/final-component adversaries fail, descriptor inheritance is proven, and normal/-O plus fresh exact replay pass.
notes:
2026-07-29 independent real replay found a second blocker: replay substitutes a private Git emulator through LEO2_BENCHMARK_GIT_EXECUTABLE, but that pathname is included in the benchmark configuration SHA and compiled into benchmark.cpp. The clean rebuild succeeds then exact argv comparison necessarily fails (candidate/replay configuration tokens differ). Make replay use a mathematically equivalent stable attested identity or version/normalize only the runner-private transport without weakening the compiled configuration proof.
2026-07-29 independent final re-audit REJECT despite 52/52 normal/-O and byte-identical real replay: only the outer Make is executed from its sealed memfd. CMake-generated recursive recipes retain lexical /usr/bin/gmake through ; strace of sealed outer make -n observed 8 nested execve('/usr/bin/gmake', ...) calls. Bind/override recursive MAKE to an immutable sealed transport and add an actual recursive-exec adversary; outer-only sealing is insufficient. Frozen implementation hashes: provenance 5ace5971..., test dda82129....
Correction to the preceding shell-rendered note: CMake-generated recursive Make recipes retain the lexical make-program pathname; the shell consumed the conventional parenthesized MAKE spelling while recording that note. The substantive strace finding and required sealed recursive transport are unchanged.
2026-07-29 recursive-Make fix frozen pending different-agent re-audit: production creates a sealed argv-preserving Make wrapper, passes MAKE=/proc/self/fd/<wrapper> on the exact Make command line so recursive GNU Make inherits it, retains wrapper/source/interpreter FDs, and requires an actual recipe-level recursive binding. Deterministic two-level mutation regression plus strace observed 8 proc-fd execve and zero mutable-path execve. 53/53 normal and 53/53 -O ResourceWarning-fatal; fresh tests-off replay byte-identical archive 82567699... and executable dbd85598.... Frozen hashes provenance 625f9035..., test 76c013a9....

title: Allow direct XOR/copy paths to report no repair executor in schema v6
description: The benchmark correctly reports selected_direct_executor=none for direct XOR/copy terminal paths, but the new schema-v6 validator requires every direct path to name output_major/source_major. Valid R=1/K=1 and direct-copy diagnostics are rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Schema v6 enforces the one-way invariant that a non-none executor implies path/rule direct, while allowing direct XOR/copy with executor none; a real K=1,R=1 one-loss benchmark JSON regression passes and transform paths still reject non-none executors.
notes: Implemented one-way executor invariant plus real K=1,R=1 direct-XOR regression. Verified executable-backed schema-v6 validation normal and python -O against a fresh Release AVX2 mode-1 build; both passed, along with API, dense-plan-policy, and high/low-duality focused tests. Awaiting reviewable commit before closure.

title: Make provenance pidfd retention exception-safe and non-rebindable
description: A pidfd opened by _retain_pidfd leaks if the post-open procfs read raises. _discover also records identities before successful retention and can later rebind an unretained PID/starttick observation without retained ancestry.
acceptance_criteria: Close every uncommitted pidfd on all exceptions; only persist race-free retained identities, keep transient observations ancestry-qualified, and never signal/rebind from numeric identity alone. Inject post-open exceptions, attach/selector exceptions, vanish/reuse/same-tick cases, and prove descendants/fds/subreaper cleanup normal/-O.
notes: 2026-07-29 independent instrumentation confirmed _proc_process_record closes /proc/PID before pidfd_open: zero proc-directory descriptors are held at the binding point. Before/after dev+inode comparison can still ABA on same-jiffy PID/inode reuse. Retain the exact no-follow proc directory fd continuously across pidfd_open and through cleanup, defer leader reap until tree quiescence, and test same numeric PID/starttime/inode substitution.

title: Bind provenance tool and archive use to the snapshotted object

title: Serialize all-K jobs per pinned CPU lane

title: Reject duplicate-key and non-finite all-K checkpoint JSON before resume

Python's default decoder accepts duplicate object keys (last value wins) and NaN/Infinity, so malformed checkpoint bytes can collapse into a mapping that passes exact recomputation and be reused.
acceptance_criteria: All persisted all-K JSON inputs, including manifest and per-cell checkpoints, are read as strict UTF-8 finite JSON with duplicate-key rejection and the expected top-level object type before semantic validation. Adversarial tests mutate an otherwise valid resumable cell and manifest with duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, invalid UTF-8, and trailing/multiple documents and prove fail-closed behavior under normal Python and python -O. title: Make campaign guardian own migrated shard lineage before coordinator death
description: The current campaign guardian is a coordinator sibling and only pidfd-tracks members it discovers in shard cgroups after coordinator death. A same-UID shard can migrate a descendant upward and kill its supervisor before the coordinator is SIGKILLed. The migrated descendant is then outside the guardian lineage and cgroup inventory, so killing tracked supervisors at the deadline can strand it. Grace periods and repeated SIGCONT do not establish ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Redesign lifecycle so the guardian owns/spawns every supervisor lineage and acts as a child subreaper, or provide an equally strong kernel-enforced containment mechanism that makes upward migration impossible. Add a real adversarial regression that migrates a descendant upward, kills its supervisor before coordinator SIGKILL, performs no harness cleanup before assertions, and proves descendant, supervisor, marker, shard scopes, and campaign scope are gone while the canonical lock remains held through cleanup. Normal and python -O ResourceWarning-fatal full suites pass; independent stable-hash audit confirms no undiscoverable process lineage remains.

title: Bind resumed all-K invocations to retained raw benchmark output
description: Successful all-K records store stdout_sha256 and parsed result but discard raw stdout, and resume validation does not require or verify the hash. A stored invocation can drop the hash or alter raw-derived result/timings, recompute cell fields, and pass. Retain bounded strict-UTF8 stdout, verify its SHA-256, strictly parse it, require exact equality to result, and enforce exact invocation keys/bounds.
acceptance_criteria: Every successful resumed invocation has exact keys and bounded raw stdout; SHA-256 and strict JSON parsing bind raw bytes to result; missing/malformed/stale/re-signed parsed mutations fail; stderr/stdout collection is bounded; normal and python -O suites pass with genuine resume acceptance.

title: Recompute resumed all-K cell results from retained invocations
description: run_allk_gap validates stored cell identity/invocations/correctness but accepts valid:true derived fields without recomputing selected samples, timing summaries, speedups, significance flags, memory, or exact keys. A tampered resume cell can fabricate a Leopard1 speedup. Reanalyze from authenticated retained invocations and require exact canonical equality (or discard derived storage), with adversarial mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Resume acceptance derives every timing/selection/speedup/significance/memory field from validated retained invocations; stored cell key set is exact; fabricated/omitted/non-finite derived fields are rejected; normal and python -O all-K unit suites pass and a resumed genuine cell remains accepted.

title: Preserve migrated-descendant cleanup when guardian finds a stopped supervisor
description: After coordinator death the campaign guardian is a sibling, not an ancestor, of shard supervisors. Immediate cgroup.kill of a SIGSTOPed supervisor destroys its subreaper while a migrated descendant is outside the cgroup, allowing that descendant to survive. Resume exact cgroup members and allow bounded supervisor cleanup before the guardian kill fallback; cover the combined parent-death/partial-launch/migration/stop case.
acceptance_criteria: Guardian resumes stopped supervisors with race-safe signaling and waits a bounded cleanup interval before cgroup.kill; parent SIGKILL with a partial launch, upward-migrated descendant, and stopped supervisor leaves no marker/process/cgroup before harness cleanup; ordinary guardian deadline remains bounded.

title: Guard exhaustive cgroups across coordinator death before shard launch
description: The coordinator creates the campaign and all pending shard cgroups before launching supervisors. SIGKILL between scope creation and supervisor launch leaves unowned empty shard scopes that no supervisor can remove, so the campaign leaks. title: Eliminate one-shot no-loss decode plan allocation
description: The leo2_decode one-shot wrapper still constructs and destroys an opaque plan when every original is present, even though plan execution is a true no-op. acceptance_criteria: Before returning success, preserve addressability checks for both K/R presence arrays, scan every original and recovery byte and reject values outside {0,1}, preserve NEED_MORE_DATA/fallback behavior for loss cases, and preserve the existing incompatible forced test-decode-mode result. Missing parity with all K originals remains a valid no-op. Invalid inputs clear/leave outputs exactly as today; valid no-loss calls inspect or modify no shard, restored, or scratch buffers, including zero-byte and odd-GF16 cases. Production-linked tests cover late invalid bitmap entries, null/overflow ranges, all/mixed/missing parity, forced hook modes, field/profile boundaries, and failure atomicity. Attribute reusable plan creation, one-shot setup, execution, and total first use separately against same-source control and exact pure-AVX2 Leopard1 where comparable; report reuse 1,2,8,64 and reject any neighboring loss-path regression over 2 percent.
notes:
2026-07-22 isolated static prototype staged on branch agent/no-loss-oneshot-4fd38c5 at base 4fd38c5, worktree /tmp/leopard-no-loss-oneshot-4fd38c5. Default-OFF macro first validates both presence ranges, uses a conservative memchr zero probe so any loss falls through to the canonical constructor, scans all K originals for exact 1 and all R recovery bytes for {0,1} before success, and deliberately falls through under non-AUTO test decode modes. title: Cancel Algorithm 5 block-zero IFFT/FFT pair

Preserve raw block-zero selected values while inverse-transforming/accumulating later blocks, forward-transform only the later contribution, then add block zero. If no later block is live, eliminate both transforms. Implement for GF8/GF16, pruned/materialized/tiled paths without changing locator multiplication, output factors, wire identity, or message-only semantics.

title: Exploit high/low affine profile duality at equal padded sides
description: When P=ceil_pow2(K) equals T=ceil_pow2(R) and N=2P, xor/translation by P maps LEGACY_HIGH_V1 parity/message coordinates to LOW_V1 message/parity coordinates. Prove the generator/wire equivalence across GF8/GF16 and all valid K,R with P=T, then evaluate executing paper Algorithm 4 through the legacy-high profile for balanced and padding-stressed cells where Algorithm 5 is slower than exact Leopard1. Keep the public profile identity legacy-high and only change its internal kernel/coordinate schedule when byte identity is proven.

acceptance_criteria: Encode and decode batches with equal shard_bytes use exact-once stable static ranges; heterogeneous, sorted, reverse-sorted, alternating, and single-heavy batches select the dynamic fallback and preserve deterministic errors and alias preflight. Candidate e621109 was rebuilt byte-identically and compared against exact Leopard main 6e5725e in five accepted one-cell ABBA campaigns; every source/build/runtime/digest/isolation verifier passed and reserved sibling nonidle jiffies were zero.
