title: Profile and specialize FF8 small-payload metadata and control
description: Measure the non-payload cost of error-locator FWHT construction, locator-scale selection, transform schedule walking, atomic mode reads, and coefficient/function dispatch at 64-byte through 4-KiB shard sizes. Precompute or specialize only bounded metadata and control work; keep the static named-register payload circuit contract and thread-safe deterministic fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle-attributed measurements separate scalar metadata/control from payload work for encode and decode; any selected cache or specialization is bounded, thread-safe, deterministic, preserves all count/loss/error paths, and changes no packed or native results. Small-payload benchmarks demonstrate a repeatable gain or the candidate is documented and rejected; allocation remains outside timed regions.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: High-value first hypothesis: SelectLocatorShift currently scans 255 shifts and all present/missing shards before payload decode. At 64 B to 4 KiB this scalar O(255*(k+r)) search can outweigh the XOR-circuit savings it selects. Measure it separately. Candidates include a payload-size break-even policy using a fixed verified shift, 255-bin log histograms with circular cost accumulation, and a bounded erasure-pattern cache; any shortcut must include the extra gates it causes in the end-to-end cost and preserve the multiplication-log-255 versus butterfly-sentinel-255 distinction.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Initial pinned CPU24 probe against immutable Release benchmark library (GCC 13.3, artifact bench SHA e556258d1c5d360f68a7afe353130ba895b9bb45c5be2f7f95fdc65ec06135f2) forced the exact auto-selected shift to isolate selection cost. k=8/r=2/max loss: selector adds about 1.55 us per decode; auto/forced ratios are 2.849 at 64 B, 2.064 at 1 KiB, 1.411 at 4 KiB, 1.021 at 64 KiB. k=128/r=128/max loss: about 43.9 us; ratios 3.747, 1.980, 1.300, 1.012. A second k=128/r=32 deterministic-pattern sweep (losses 1,4,16,32) selected nonzero shifts 68,97,145,117 but forced-selected versus forced-zero times differed by roughly -0.2% to +4.0% through 4 KiB while auto search added about 27-29 us, making auto/zero 3.70-3.02 at 64 B, 1.95-1.75 at 1 KiB, 1.26-1.22 at 4 KiB. At 64 KiB selected versus zero was generally within 1%; one low-iteration auto outlier requires ABBA repetition. This strongly motivates a size-aware fixed-shift path, but these probes are directional evidence only: promote only after ABBA, more patterns/seeds, 1 MiB, frequency controls, and post-derivative end-to-end correctness.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: The user requirement still favors the simplest legal constants, so first optimize exact selection rather than merely bypass it. Flip SelectLocatorShift from shift-outer to term-outer accumulation: keep uint16_t gates[255] and depths[255] (safe maxima are 256*23 and 256*17), and for each positive or inverse log add one contiguous 255-entry rotation of duplicated fixed gate/depth arrays. This removes per-shift pointer-presence tests, CanonicalLog/modulo branches, and enables baseline SIMD/vectorization while producing the identical gates/depth/lowest-shift tie break. Independently exhaust all synthetic log/sign histograms and real erasure patterns against the old selector. Only after that evaluate a size threshold if the exact vectorized selector still fails to amortize.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Exact selector prototype preserves the current all-255-shift objective and lowest-shift tie break while canonicalizing multiplication log 255 to log 0. It gathers at most 256 signed terms, accumulates duplicated rotated gate rows into bounded uint16 totals, finds the gate minimum, then evaluates depth only for gate-tied shifts. Differential prototype validation: 64,770 rotation cells, 510 signed one-term cases, 260,100 signed two-term cases, 5,000 random lists, and 106,750 valid FF8 shapes across baseline/AVX2/AVX512 builds. Portable selector medians improved 9.18x to 38.67x across k/r shapes (25.3x overall median). AVX2 accumulation adds 22-30% locally but will be considered only after portable end-to-end evidence; AVX512BW did not beat AVX2 and SSE2 register form spilled/regressed. Next action: integrate the portable exact algorithm with exhaustive production differential tests and measure end-to-end before adding ISA complexity.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Progress checkpoint e8d93dc/82e1e4c: exact locator-scale selection is implemented and retained without relaxing the simplest-circuit objective. It still minimizes total XOR2 gates, then dependency depth, then numeric shift over all 255 legal common scales; multiplier log 255 canonicalizes to log 0. Four generated 510-entry rotations replace shift-major scoring. The 256-term bounds are 5,888 gates and 4,352 depth, with no mutable cache or payload-data lookup and at most one selector call per decode. Independent coverage passed 261,129 differential cases, all 65,536 raw-log/shift rotation coordinates, the production k=254/r=2 256-term path, JSON/CSV schedule-corpus shifts, Release, Debug, ASan+UBSan portable-only, SIMD-disabled Release, Clang 18 Release, generator check, VS manifest, full Release 41/41 CTest, codegen audits, and a restarted clean bug-hunt pass. Pinned GCC 13.3 Release CPU24 C-A-A-C measurements used packed AVX2, ff8xor AVX-512 ZMM, four-buffer disabled, native planes, transposes/allocation/verification excluded. Selector speedups for 9/20/36/72/144/256 terms were 7.69x/13.29x/18.34x/22.31x/27.42x/32.13x. Native decode candidate/control time ratios across 20 schedules per size were 0.5014 at 1 KiB, 0.7565 at 4 KiB, 0.9965 at 64 KiB, and 1.0058 at 1 MiB; packed-decode-normalized ratios were 0.5005/0.7464/0.9827/0.9980. All 80 production shifts matched all four runs. Large payload is honestly neutral. Linux GCC and MinGW emit SSE2 loops with no normal calls; AArch64 GCC emits NEON. Candidate/control benchmark SHA-256 values are 873e5d8f7b3ac6f90d5ff762581e5d6c4d1c80cab9f4fc458d5694e1e8d92769 and 466e2142f11d3500a451b432eeef731cb5d0b994a4177b433768efbcac019021. Keep .45 in_progress: remaining acceptance work is phase/cycle attribution for locator FWHT construction, schedule walking, atomic mode reads, and coefficient/function dispatch for encode and decode at 64 B through 4 KiB, followed by bounded specialization or candid rejection. Host PMU access remains denied by perf_event_paranoid=4.

title: Harden balanced promotion manifest semantics and path attestation
description: Independent review rejected candidate 9fd237c because promotion conditions were inert metadata, validation accepted re-signed semantic weakening, exact-main/forced round-order metadata was conflated, main-compatible aligned tails lacked selected-mode exact-main artifacts, transform-group gating contradicted K/byte claims, interior T=128 K coverage was missing, and AUTO rejection cells did not attest the selected decode fallback. acceptance_criteria: A deterministic staged command consumes a validated survivor set and cannot emit non-surviving later cells; pristine regeneration or equivalent checks reject re-signed semantic edits; exact-main and forced runner ordering is represented separately; aligned tail sizes receive exact-main confirmation and only non-aligned tails are labeled same-binary-only; K={96,112,120,124,125} plus immediate transition-neighbor refinement are covered; AUTO rejection controls authenticate the selected path; adversarial self-tests cover each finding; independent rereview is clean.
notes:
2026-07-18 recurring review of balanced evidence head e86fcbd found two fail-closed gaps; integration is blocked pending fixes and rereview. First, each schema-v5 runtime dependency file identity was not bound to its raw loader_path, so a coherently re-signed swap could pass current/offline/scope validation. Second, cache inventories were only cross-compared between mutually editable summaries, so coherently truncating a cache index could pass. Fixes must add independent binding and adversarial regressions, then receive a clean rereview.
Independent rereview of 436f3f6 was NOT CLEAN with six reproducible gaps: offline/balanced accepted noncanonical loader paths producer rejects; root normalization rewrote mere string prefixes; verify_exact_manifest had validate-then-reopen TOCTOU; one selector mutation test failed only because its plan path was absent; ordinary shared-dependency coherent deletion was not independently detected; and retained cache-directory text provides three-way consistency but not protection from fully coherent re-signing. Fix must align producer/offline/scope, use component-aware normalization, bind exact verified bytes, make the test non-vacuous, and narrow authenticity/completeness claims to what unkeyed retained evidence actually proves unless independent provenance is added.
Second rereview of 2987213 confirmed all six prior fixes but remained NOT CLEAN: component-boundary normalization leaves the real baseline source root embedded after CMake target `.dir` in external-source object paths and archive recipe text (eight actual-scope occurrences), so equivalent baseline roots normalize differently. Fix must recognize only the CMake `<target>.dir/<absolute-source>` encoding without reopening sibling-prefix collisions, and assert no bound root remains in an actual clean v5 scope.
Independent rereview of d2d9cc1 remains NOT CLEAN with two new exact reproductions. (1) Producer, offline, and normalized scope accept an executable recipe linking a foreign absolute /tmp/libleopard.a when the declared archive has the same basename; coherent text/identity re-signing passes. Require exactly one operand semantically equal to the validated archive and same-basename foreign/sibling mutations in all three paths. (2) verify_exact_manifest uses an inode-bound snapshot, but select_survivors re-stats/re-hashes the manifest path for its reference after verification; an interleaving replacement yields a post-verification reference SHA while payload_digest remains from accepted bytes. Plumb the accepted byte identity through selection and add a select-level interleaving regression. Prior eight retained-root defect is fixed (parent 2987213 reproduced 8, d2d9cc1 actual v5 scope 0).
close_reason: Balanced evidence semantics and path attestation are independently audited and fail closed

title: Wire sparse exact schedules into production encode or add encode plans
description: Audit found public production plumbing absent: production EncodeLayout reserves no schedule suffix, PrepareSparseEncodePlans is a no-op outside test hooks, and leo2_encode always passes an empty exact-plan view. acceptance_criteria: Selected design has no hot-path allocation; exact scratch and one-byte-short/overflow/alias queries are correct; compilation happens before public writes and failure is atomic; arbitrary tails/GF16 padded odd, partial masks, batch and shared-codec concurrency pass; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2/direct-generator parity and re-decode recovery match; production selected-path tests lock thresholds; every promoted cell clears >=5% with neighbors above -2%, or a documented negative result leaves AUTO prefix.

title: Protect one-shot decode presence arrays from output and scratch overlap
description: Whole-codebase API alias audit found that leo2_decode() copies original_present/recovery_present into its reusable plan, then calls the public leo2_decode_plan_execute() path with protected_metadata=NULL. ValidateDecodeBuffers therefore protects only original/recovery/restored pointer arrays. A restored output shard or caller scratch span may overlap either const presence array; execution returns LEO2_SUCCESS and overwrites caller metadata despite the immutable setup contract. Repro observed scratch_presence_result=0 with mutated bytes and output_presence_result=0 with mutated bytes.
acceptance_criteria: One-shot decode preflight protects exact original_present[K] and recovery_present[R] spans against every writable restored shard, caller scratch, and pointer metadata according to existing whole-call atomic overlap policy; legal disjoint calls and reusable-plan execute remain unchanged; rejection returns LEO2_OVERLAP before writes and preserves all inputs/outputs; focused partial/duplicate/unaligned/boundary cases, allocation audit, ASan/UBSan and full API/alias suites pass.
close_reason: Presence metadata is now included in one-shot decode overlap preflight with focused Release and sanitizer regression evidence.

comments.author: catid
comments.text: Fixed in root commit b62147b (worker source commit 6bef013): one-shot decode now protects both original_present[K] and recovery_present[R] as immutable metadata spans during preflight. Worker Release API/alias/allocation suites passed 6/6 and Clang 18 ASan+UBSan passed 6/6; independent root focused Release gate passed 6/6 (api, public_api_contract, batch_aliasing, decode_plan_schedule, direct_encode, encode_concurrency).

title: Separate hook-enabled tests from installable production library
description: LEO2_BUILD_TESTS defaults ON and currently compiles LEO2_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS into the same leopard target that benchmarks and install/export use. acceptance_criteria: Central test allocation uses paired portable helpers (_aligned_malloc/_aligned_free on MSVC, posix_memalign/free elsewhere); the complete native MSVC or clang-cl tests-on configuration compiles; Linux strict builds and allocation/guard tests remain clean; no allocator family is mismatched.
notes: 2026-07-18 implementation commit 3a00fd8 converts all four unconditionally built affected tests (API, random, boundaries, transform differential) to paired _aligned_malloc/_aligned_free on MSVC and posix_memalign/free elsewhere; the Linux-only initialization-thread helper was hardened too. GCC Release rebuilt all five targets; focused 10/10 tests passed, and full Release 73/73 passed before the allocator-only change. Native MSVC/clang-cl is not installed on this host, so keep the bead open until the downstream Windows/backend portability gate performs the required tests-on compile.

title: Prevent audit output from deleting executables
description: Audit clears its output before loading/validating the manifest and protects only manifest/results paths. If --output aliases an API/pruned fuzz target, the attestation nm tool, the Python interpreter or another executable, audit can unlink it before failing live verification.
acceptance_criteria: Create and audit never unlink an existing executable; audit also protects every target and instrumentation-tool path named by even a not-yet-trusted manifest; manifest/results protections remain; symlink/relative aliases are resolved; self-tests prove target/tool/interpreter bytes and modes remain unchanged; stale non-executable outputs still clear fail-closed.
close_reason: Create/audit/leak paths resolve and protect target, tool, manifest and result aliases before deletion, require private regular evidence, and reject symlink/hard-link attacks. Self-test adversarial matrix and independent review pass; production executables remain unchanged.

title: Attest sanitizer instrumentation in linked Leopard2 core

A build that sanitizes fuzz_replay.cpp but links an unsanitized leopard library can pass, contrary to the documented codec-plus-executable coverage claim.
acceptance_criteria: A function compiled in a representative linked Leopard2 core translation unit reports ASan+UBSan compile instrumentation; replay attestation and v4 validator require both core booleans; a sanitized-wrapper/unsanitized-core build fails; the real fully sanitized build passes create/run/audit; production tests-off library remains free of public attestation API.
close_reason: Core sanitizer compile attestation lives behind test hooks and is linked only through noninstalled leopard_test_hooks after b7f3ed0. Wrapper-only instrumentation is rejected; production archive isolation passes; real core+replay ASan/UBSan audit passed 60/60.

title: Bind sanitizer instrumentation identity in fuzz evidence
description: The v3 campaign labels ASan and UBSan active based only on requested environment and executable hashes. It accepts arbitrary executables, and its modeled Python helper can be audited as sanitizer-active despite carrying no sanitizer instrumentation. This makes the published sanitizer scope stronger than the evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign creation fails closed unless each target provides content-bound, independently validated ASan+UBSan instrumentation evidence; the attestation is bound into the manifest and audit; unsanitized, mismatched, forged, stale and mixed-target binaries are rejected; real Clang18 ASan+UBSan fuzz targets pass; modeled generic process self-tests no longer produce falsely sanitizer-active audit artifacts.
close_reason: 3843db4 binds executable hashes, live role/runtime attestation, ELF nm symbol digest and tool identity. Unsanitized/mixed/stale mutations fail; integrated Clang targets report ASan+UBSan compile/runtime true and audited 60/60.

title: Bind LSAN_OPTIONS in sanitizer campaign and leak gate
description: The v3 fuzz campaign signs ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 but inherits ambient LSAN_OPTIONS through leopard2_lab before overlay. compiler-rt gives LSAN_OPTIONS precedence, so an ambient detect_leaks=1 can re-enable LeakSanitizer helper processes during parallel one-process evidence, while ambient detect_leaks=0 can silently disable the separate serial leak gate.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical parallel jobs bind both ASAN_OPTIONS and LSAN_OPTIONS with leak detection disabled; the separate serial leak command binds both with leak detection enabled; poisoned inherited environments cannot change either phase; schema/audit/self-tests bind the exact scope; real parallel and serial sanitizer gates pass.
close_reason: Canonical v4 parallel and v3 leak companion now bind ASAN_OPTIONS, LSAN_OPTIONS and UBSAN_OPTIONS explicitly, including detect_leaks and empty suppression paths. Poisoned-environment mutations pass self-tests; audited 60-job parallel and serial campaigns passed.

title: Integrate C1 sparse-input pruning into shortened encoder block IFFTs
description: The mature high/low encoder source-staging path now removes active-prefix copies, but a shortened or final partial inverse block still memset-initializes every inactive suffix shard because later regular layers read them. Compile immutable inverse C1 input-prefix schedules per codec/block shape and evaluate an allocation-free from-sources executor that treats shortened leaves as structural zeros without materializing the unused suffix. Preserve the regular staged path for dense blocks.
acceptance_criteria: GF8/GF16 high and low parity remains byte-identical to the padded legacy/direct oracle for every prefix length, arbitrary byte tails and all backends; null shortened pointers are never read; caller sources remain immutable; scratch writes/zeroed shards and memory traffic are counted; setup and execution are separate; deterministic dispatcher promotes only >=10% credible shortened-region wins with no >2% neighboring regression; Release, ASan/UBSan, TSan, fuzz and aliases pass.
close_reason: Candidate rejected by measured promotion gate; committed reproducible negative evidence, no AUTO/hot-path change, correctness and full Release gates pass.

title: Make the portable FF8 XOR binary baseline-ISA safe
description: The inherited CMake build applies -march=native to the whole library, so the nominal uint64_t Portable path and runtime dispatcher may contain build-host instructions before feature dispatch. Isolate packed and bitsliced SIMD code behind target-specific translation units or target attributes and compile public dispatch, scalar metadata, and portable kernels for an explicit baseline ISA. Preserve the optimized AVX2 and AVX-512 paths without making the experimental backend default.
acceptance_criteria: On x86-64, a strict opcode census proves dispatcher/portable objects contain no AVX, AVX2, AVX-512, GFNI, or other post-baseline instructions; runtime CPUID plus OSXSAVE/XGETBV gates every SIMD entry; forced Portable, SIMD128, AVX2, AVX-512VL, and AVX-512ZMM outputs remain byte-identical where supported. GCC and Clang Release/Debug/sanitizer builds pass, an AVX-disabled or x86-64-v1 build/run passes, unsupported forced modes fail safely, and native optimized benchmark performance is measured so portability is not purchased with an undisclosed fast-path regression.
close_reason: Baseline-ISA isolation, feature-safe dispatch, GCC/Clang/AVX-off/sanitizer matrices, adversarial flag census, and build-system regressions completed in bc40122/992a1ee.

title: Sanitizer campaign misclassifies LeakSanitizer exit helper as oversubscription
description: Clang 18 ASan+UBSan pruned-transform replays briefly fork a same-executable LeakSanitizer helper at clean process exit. The lab runtime monitor treats the two-process instant as forbidden workload oversubscription, sends SIGTERM, and non-deterministically marks otherwise passing seeds evidence_invalid. In a 56-job 8192-iteration campaign, all 28 API seeds passed but 21/28 pruned seeds were invalid; exact standalone reproduction passed while ps confirmed the exit helper.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve strict workload oversubscription detection while making the versioned sanitizer campaign deterministic under Clang LeakSanitizer; document whether leak checking is separated; add mutation/regression tests; an audited multi-seed ASan+UBSan campaign passes without hiding real sanitizer failures or inherited OpenMP oversubscription.
notes: Reproducer artifacts: build/high-input-fuzz/manifest.json and results/merged-results.json; 35 success, 21 evidence_invalid. Standalone seed 2737689285420620469 / 8192 passed and briefly showed parent+child in one session at exit.
close_reason: Resolved by strict separation of parallel ASan/UBSan one-process evidence and exact serial LSan v3 replay. All nine child defects are closed; adversarial suppression/alias/stale/instrumentation mutations pass; integrated 60-seed campaigns audit cleanly with full iteration parity and resumability.

title: Decode-plan output alias mutates presence metadata before validation
description: leo2_decode_plan_create cleared plan_out before completing overlap validation when one presence bitmap was NULL. If plan_out aliased the non-NULL presence bitmap, the function mutated caller metadata and returned LEO2_INVALID_ARGUMENT instead of LEO2_OVERLAP.
acceptance_criteria: Validate both non-NULL presence spans and their overlap with plan_out before any output write; return LEO2_OVERLAP without mutation for original- and recovery-symmetric cases; add C ABI regressions; pass Release, ASan/UBSan, TSan, strict compiler, reduced-field, and a second independent clean audit pass.
notes: Independent whole-code hunt found and reproduced this defect. Fix integrated as commit 1e893ea (agent source a7ec446).
close_reason: Fixed in 1e893ea. Symmetric C ABI regressions verify LEO2_OVERLAP and byte-for-byte metadata preservation. Agent evidence: full Release 69/69; GCC ASan+UBSan 6/6; strict GCC 2/2; strict Clang ASan+UBSan 3/3; Clang TSan concurrency 3/3; reduced-field 1/1; GCC -fanalyzer clean; repeat audit found no further confirmed bugs.

title: Audit GF16 odd-byte rejection and padded-odd profile
description: An explicit native GF16 codec cannot universally support odd physical shard lengths while transmitting only B bytes: the trailing coordinate is projected to an alphabet of 256 values, and legal long GF16 parameter sets can exceed the MDS limit over that projected alphabet. The in-tree executable singular witness and decision leopard-79h.39.1 establish the constraint. Audit and harden the versioned GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 solution, which explicitly uses physical B+1; ensure native odd-GF16 requests reject deterministically, AUTO uses GF8 where legal, and docs/API make the physical/wire distinction unambiguous.
acceptance_criteria: Revalidate the projected-tail singular witness; all requested odd logical sizes (1,3,17,33,65,129,257,1025) pass encode and every valid erasure decode under scalar and every available SIMD backend using GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 with physical B+1, including direct oracle, parity rebuild, unaligned/guard and ASan+UBSan coverage. Native explicit GF16 odd physical lengths return the documented deterministic result, AUTO selects GF8 where legal, even-byte GF16 wire compatibility is unchanged, and no API path silently drops or synthesizes a transmitted byte.
notes:
2026-07-18 audit correction: initial observation K=17,R=2,B=129 returning LEO2_UNSUPPORTED was not by itself a correctness bug. Universal native odd-byte GF16 is mathematically impossible for the full supported count range without changing physical wire length. Scope revised to validate the existing versioned padded-odd solution and rejection contract; never weaken MDS behavior to satisfy the original wording.
Completed in commit bca2231 (review branch 9051fab) without adding a lossy native profile. Independent executable witness reconfirmed projected one-byte-tail singularity: low V1 K=2,R=256 rows 0/256 rank 14, collision message (0,1), full outputs (0,0x100). GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1 B+1 hardening covers logical sizes 1,3,17,33,65,129,257,1025; high K3/R2 and low K2/R3; all 336 mixed loss masks; scalar direct parity oracle; physical+payload recovery; parity rebuild; unaligned guarded inputs; native/padded-core odd rejection; no-loss no-op; AUTO GF8. Counts: 165 payload cases, 27,544 direct symbols, 757 restored shards, 498 MDS basis recoveries, 336 patterns, 1,864 guard checks. Scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 byte-identical; strict GCC -Werror and Clang18 ASan+UBSan/leaks clean. Fresh-worktree structural test initially failed only because sse2neon was uninitialized; after submodule init every one of 69 Release tests passed individually.
close_reason: Padded-odd profile and deterministic native rejection hardened with proof, oracle, backend, guard, sanitizer, and full-suite evidence.

title: Bug hunt V: release-candidate whole-codebase audit

title: Fuse GF16 Algorithm 5 block IFFTs into syndrome accumulation
description: After the GF8 checkpoint, remove the analogous separate GF16 later-block IFFT plus XOR syndrome pass in prepared, planned, and tiled Algorithm 5. Preserve the mature 64/128-byte fused-versus-split policy and ALTMAP wire layout; exact-pruned schedules may remain a separately tracked fallback.

notes: Promoted GF16 mature-transform Algorithm 5 syndrome accumulation in commit c9648c4 (review branch 354274b). Post-rebase Release 73/73; ASan+UBSan focused 5/5; strict/context/schedule/high-acceptance/pruning/tails/differential/API gates green. Exact recovery/digests unchanged. Valid matched-source pre/post results (8 process medians/provider, pinned CPU20): AVX2 K4096/R16/4KiB tiled +9.38%, materialized +8.32%; K4096/R8 +8.94%; K1000/R16 +8.65%; SSSE3 K4096/R16 +8.56%. title: Add scalable allocation-free batch alias preflight metadata
description: The deterministic cross-item safety fix intentionally uses allocation-free O(B^2*(K+R)) pairwise sweeps because the existing batch ABI provides no batch-wide metadata workspace. This is correct but can dominate the plan's 1024+ stripe target. Add a size-queryable caller-owned preflight workspace, explicitly reserved context storage, immutable batch plan, or equivalent bounded design that flattens/sorts all readable/writable/metadata/scratch intervals in O(M log M) or better for M=B*(K+R), with no hot-path allocation. Preserve the current API as a correct fallback, shared immutable inputs, strict whole-batch atomic rejection, UINT32_MAX arithmetic checks, concurrent contexts, deterministic errors and true no-op semantics. Integrate with caller-executor/prewarm work rather than hiding allocation in the first batch call.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark B=1,8,64,1024 and larger feasible batches across small/large K,R; fast preflight is allocation-free after explicit setup, exact for partial/duplicate/metadata/scratch overlaps and unequal tails, ASan/UBSan/TSan clean, and does not regress small batches more than 2 percent or narrow existing contracts.
notes: 2026-07-18 completed by commits 2b85bfd, 3364373, 2c214e7, and 1d44654. API v4 adds size-queryable caller-owned O(M log M) batch preflight storage while retaining the exact allocation-free compatibility fallback. Final Release covered 83/83; settled Clang18 ASan+UBSan covered 72/72; independent review found no overflow, alias, ABI, atomicity, allocation, concurrency, or worker-order defect. Batch evidence covers sizes 1, 8, 64, and 1024 plus 514-item compatibility cases, 64 concurrent calls, exact one-byte-short/capacity/overlap failures, and clean allocation audits; docs/leopard2_batch_preflight.md records the small-batch nonregression and large-batch gains.

title: Reject setup output handles that alias immutable inputs
description: Public setup APIs clear output handles before reading immutable inputs. If context_out aliases leo2_context_options, codec_out aliases leo2_codec_options, or plan_out aliases the original/recovery presence arrays, the clear mutates input metadata and can change validation or create the wrong object. Before the first output write, overflow-safely describe declared readable spans and reject output-handle overlap. Preserve the documented null-on-ordinary-failure invariant; document the exceptional alias rejection where writing null would itself corrupt immutable input. Cover guard pages, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, short/forward option prefixes, presence arrays, normal failure nulling, Release and ASan/UBSan.
notes: Integrated primary fix fad7d6e plus root follow-up 27a01ae. Context/codec/plan setup reject output-handle overlap with declared immutable option/presence spans before first write; ordinary failures retain null-on-failure, while overlap or arithmetic-unrepresentable spans leave the handle untouched. Root follow-up validates the minimum size_t prefix arithmetic before dereferencing struct_size and adds near-UINTPTR_MAX option-prefix cases. Coverage includes exact/forward-extension/v1-adjacent aliases, presence arrays, guard pages, ordinary nulling. Agent GCC Release 2/2 and Clang ASan+UBSan 2/2; root Release focused 2/2 and ASan+UBSan ABI 1/1, diff check clean.
close_reason: Setup self-clobber bug fixed, prefix arithmetic hardened, and focused sanitizer/ABI gates pass in fad7d6e + 27a01ae.

Decode has the same second-pass scratch overwrite and restored metadata may alias writable regions. Define descriptor-array spans and lifetime precisely; reject overlap with scratch and writable outputs before mutating scratch; cover encode/decode/plan/batch, partial overlaps, guard pages, tails and sanitizers. Coordinate cross-item rules with .14.3.
notes: Integrated in 263c953. Reproduced pre-fix K=4/R=2 scratch-resident pointer-array case returned SUCCESS with wrong parity. Encode/decode now describe original/recovery/restored pointer-array spans overflow-safely before scratch mutation, reject metadata versus scratch/writable outputs, retain immutable sharing, and protect the entire batch-item array. Tests cover descriptor arrays versus scratch/output, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, batch metadata, multi-output corruption, and exact parity/recovery after rejection. Agent: GCC13 Release, Clang18 ASan+UBSan, Clang18 TSan public API; focused Release and reduced-field matrices pass. Root after integration: full Release 69/69 and focused ASan+UBSan 6/6.

Implement static scheduling for regular batch/transform work, per-worker scratch ownership, detected allowed-CPU topology, optional affinity, first-touch allocation, NUMA-node stripe partitioning, and per-node state where cross-node writes hurt. Preserve caller control and deterministic errors; do not pin unexpectedly unless requested. Validate TSan, oversubscription, cpusets, heterogeneous item costs, 1..available scaling, and external 128-core/multi-NUMA when available.

title: Build production existing-path dispatcher and crossover table
description: The production dispatcher currently uses a few narrow thresholds and does not generally model available parity, loss shape, shard size, backend, or thread/batch execution class. Build an offline deterministic crossover table for existing production direct/generic/Algorithm4/Algorithm5/materialized/tiled/pruned paths keyed only by runtime facts with defined semantics: K,R,parent,loss pattern, shard bytes, field, backend, available parity, thread budget, and evidence-backed single-versus-multiple batch class. Exact batch count and plan reuse remain benchmark/reporting dimensions under decision .38.4.2, not V1 caller hints. Validate held-out exact-main and neighboring cells; no online first-call benchmarking; profile/wire identity must remain CPU-independent. Keep exact-profile research in C10 separate.

Exact item_count is already a call input to scheduling; per-item decode scratch stays bounded by the ordinary plan query; immutable plans can be shared across different realized reuse. title: Make batch cross-item aliasing deterministic and safe
description: Plan/API audit found encode/decode validate scratch/input/output disjointness only within each batch item. Two items may reuse writable scratch/output or overlap another item input; this executes sequentially with thread_count=1 but races/corrupts under a pool, making behavior machine-dependent. Define cross-item alias rules precisely, permit shared immutable inputs, reject every unsupported writable overlap before starting work, keep lowest-index error deterministic, and avoid unbounded hot-path allocation (use bounded caller/context metadata or a size-queryable batch preflight design). Cover unequal shard sizes, tails, item_count boundaries, shared inputs, duplicate scratch/output, partial overlaps, scalar/pool/TSan.
notes:

Batch encode/decode now perform a read-only addressability/metadata phase followed by allocation-free whole-batch alias preflight before any item executes; shared immutable inputs remain legal, every writable output/scratch overlap is deterministic LEO2_OVERLAP, later ordinary errors cannot partially execute earlier items, metadata-overlap rejection preserves every scratch byte, and no-loss batch remains a true no-op. Evidence: implementation branch full Release 61/61; strict Clang -Werror 2/2; ASan+UBSan 2/2; TSan 2/2. Root current focused Release passed, then commit 46a? adds 257-item decode plus encode boundary coverage in both thread_count=1/4 contexts and passes. O(B^2*(K+R)) fallback complexity is explicit; scalable caller/context metadata is follow-up leopard-79h.14.5.
Correction to the preceding shorthand: the root large-batch encode+decode regression commit is exactly 9dbb2bd; its focused Release CTest passed 1/1 at current HEAD.

title: Cache permanent puncture contribution for dense active locator setup
description: Codec setup currently caches permanent locator evaluations only when sparse-direct construction is preferred. Dense active-N Walsh plans call PrepareDecode on the combined permanent+dynamic+virtual erasure mask each time, contrary to the plan's permanent-contribution reuse requirement. Derive and cache the dense active-Walsh permanent contribution (or equivalent transform-domain state), combine dynamic erasures without changing locator derivatives/reveal factors, and prove exhaustive GF4/GF8 plus broad GF16 add/remove/swap/puncture/virtual-erasure equality, concurrency, setup memory and crossover before production use.
notes: Resolved as a tested negative rather than adding a dominated dense cache. Deterministic survivor selection retains exactly K of K+R transmitted coordinates, so every plan has exactly R non-permanent real+virtual erasures; codec setup's IsDirectLocatorPreferred(N,R) therefore predicts the sparse/direct region exactly. Existing sparse permanent cache saves p*(N-1) additions. Both executable dense candidates (coordinate-domain and post-kernel transform-domain) retain two active-N Walsh transforms and N products while adding N modular additions and N persistent symbols, so union-Walsh strictly dominates. Integrated commits 0e60ca8 and 616eff5. Root Release locator replay: 9,894,532 entries, 9,647 exact-R selection patterns, 256 concurrent shared-base preparations, structural cases at N=2..65536. Worker gates: GCC13 strict Werror 3/3, Debug assertion 3/3, Clang18 ASan+UBSan 3/3, TSan locator pass. Full derivation and reproduction in docs/leopard2_permanent_locator_cache.md.
close_reason: Dense cache rejected by proved operation/pass dominance; existing sparse policy proven complete and guarded by exhaustive tests/debug invariant.

title: Serialize legacy and Leopard2 global initialization
description: Manual audit found leo_init()/leo_init_ unsynchronized: legacy m_Initialized, FF8/FF16 initialization flags/table allocation and backend SelectedOps/qualification state can be read/written concurrently. Leopard2 EnsureInitialized serializes only Leopard2 callers, not a direct legacy leo_init racing context creation. title: Design versioned odd-byte GF16 tail profile
description: The current GF16 symbol/wire representation cannot provide a universal fixed-B-byte MDS contract for odd B; commit d748620 documents the counterexample and safely supports every positive even length. Define the explicit new mathematics/API/wire identity needed for odd byte tails, comparing padded wire storage, GF8-hybrid final-byte coding, and paired-stripe semantics. Implement the selected versioned profile or revise the public contract with a proof-backed limitation. Never silently change legacy_high_v1 or low_v1.
design: Select LEO2_SHARD_LAYOUT_GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1. For odd application payload B, every systematic and parity coordinate physically stores W=B+1 bytes. Systematic packing is payload||0; parity byte W-1 is generally nonzero and must be transmitted. Core arithmetic remains the existing compact even-byte GF16 V1 at W bytes, so high/low profile, coordinate map, field representation, codec coefficients, and plan locators do not change. The layout is explicit codec identity and never AUTO-selected. Existing native/even behavior stays byte-identical. Reject hybrid as a general solution because its GF8 component is MDS only in a GF8-limited coordinate region; keep paired stripes experimental because they change recovery to K jointly received pairs.
acceptance_criteria: A source-backed design selects or rejects each candidate; serialized profile/field identity and exact shard-storage semantics are specified; direct algebra proves systematic/MDS behavior for the selected construction; byte sizes 1..65 and 1023..1025 pass direct differential, guards, ASan and UBSan under the new identifier; legacy/even-byte outputs remain bit-identical; migration and incompatibility are documented.
notes:
2026-07-16 research disposition: padded physical storage is the only small construction preserving the single-codeword any-K-coordinate contract for every GF16-legal K,R. Hybrid adds no current AUTO coverage and cannot exceed a proven GF8 count bound; paired stripes require identical/joint erasure semantics. Implement as a framing layout around existing even-byte GF16 with payload-to-wire query and allocation-free pack/unpack, plus identity/mismatch and direct-oracle tests. Claim is intentionally active despite the inherited public-API blocker because the isolated versioned framing work can proceed; final API freezing remains gated on leopard-79h.10.

Independent direct GF16/MDS coverage: 144 payload cases, 22,096 direct symbols, 446 restored shards, 448 basis recoveries; high/low specialized, generic, AUTO transform and direct-repair paths; batch/concurrent/guard/unaligned/overflow/pad/API-v1/short-enum ABI cases. Fresh Release 18/18 and CUDA-optional 1/1; GCC ASan+UBSan 18/18 plus focused 4/4; TSan focused padded/concurrent/ABI passed under setarch; C/Python identity 186 direct checks, 81 malformed and 20,000 mutations. auto/scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 source fingerprint 076d16f953d643485dcdd1ab084f887c572ff2558f715380cee7236c511c5d58 produced identical outputs. Independent review found no remaining correctness, ABI, wire, alias, no-loss, identity, dispatch, or concurrency blocker.

description: A release GF16-only build emits -Wunused-function for BypassTinyGF8AVX2HighPrunedSchedules because the helper is compiled without GF8 while every call is field-guarded. Put the definition under the same GF8 guard and rerun the reduced-field build.

close_reason: GF8-only tiny-schedule helper is now guarded in 3d65268. GF16-only Release build completed without the unused-function warning; dual-field focused tests remained green.

title: Bound and repair build-provenance compiler replay regression
description: The Release gate leopard2_build_provenance_compiler_replay timed out at 303 seconds under a 2 GiB cgroup, then a direct isolated rerun emitted multiple unittest errors/failures and climbed to about 2.93 GiB RSS under a 3 GiB cgroup. The scope was stopped before OOM. Reproduce by unittest class, identify the unbounded allocation or retained data and each functional failure, make the test resource-bounded, and preserve its fail-closed provenance guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: Every unittest class and the registered CTest pass from a clean Release build with logged peak RSS and no OOM; the registered 300-second timeout is credible; adversarial mutation and detached-process containment coverage remains intact; add regressions for the allocation root cause and functional failures.

title: Screen a P128/B64 generated Algorithm 4 terminal and generic crossover
description: Hypothesis: balanced GF8 partial-high-loss shapes K=R=95 and K=R=128 at B=64/128 remain slower than exact Leopard main because Algorithm 4 still pays multiple materialization passes. A generated stage-range P=128,N=256 terminal may fuse those passes; however an evidence-backed generic fallback may be cheaper at the smallest cells and must be screened first.
design: First expose a same-binary forced-generic control before translated-low early return and measure it against mature Algorithm 4. Only if a real gap remains, generate bounded AVX2 stage ranges that fuse locator-weighted input, inverse stages, derivative combination, final FFT, inverse locator, and requested scatter without fully unrolling every operation. Oracles: direct interpolation, mature generic decoder, existing Algorithm 4, scalar/AVX2 differential. Targets: K95/R95 L47/L94 and K128/R128 L64/L127 at B64/B128; neighbors B63/65/127/129/192 and full-loss controls. Require text <=10KiB, no EVEX/spills, lower CI95 >=1.05 in promoted cells, no >2% neighbor regression; kill after generic control if it already closes the gap or if code footprint/pressure is excessive.
acceptance_criteria: Forced-path attribution is authenticated; every targeted and neighboring loss pattern matches independent oracles; Release/strict/ASan/UBSan pass; immutable exact-main ABBA supports a deterministic dispatch or records a reproducible negative result with no dead production code.
notes: Accepted and promoted exact P=128,N=256,B=64 AVX2 Algorithm 4 terminal. Implementation/test/evidence commits on agent branch: 0b99848, 67e3d0c, 78feabb, 2beb161, cf41046, 5ff9a3f, 03a2bf7, f59788e, cf1074f. Independent direct-RS, mature Algorithm 4, and generic decoder differentials pass for K95/R95 L47/L94 and K128/R128 L64/L127, including unaligned/guarded buffers, scratch redzones, aliases, selector boundaries, and 89 public-route probes. Authoritative 9-round exact-main ABBA on CPU13/sibling29 accepted all four cells: exact-main speedup 1.2654x CI[1.2608,1.2700], 1.1985x CI[1.1905,1.2066], 1.2552x CI[1.2469,1.2636], and 1.1619x CI[1.1558,1.1681], with zero credible regressions in 14 neighbors. Timed/promoted .text and kernel-object hashes match. Evidence: experiments/leopard2/alg4_p128/results/p128_b64_terminal_amd_9950x3d_20260803.json. GCC Release full build passed; 132/134 registered Release CTests passed after reruns, with candidate-related failures fixed. Unrelated harness failures were captured as leopard-79h.16.6 and .16.7. Clang18 -Werror focused build/test passed. ASan+UBSan focused test passed at 90,624 KiB peak RSS. All substantial runs were serialized under cgroup memory ceilings with swap disabled.
close_reason: Promoted exact bounded cells with direct-oracle correctness, strict/sanitizer gates, and authoritative exact-main ABBA evidence exceeding the 5% lower-CI threshold without neighbor regression.

title: Eliminate low-encoder dense partial-block result scatter
description: Eliminate the remaining scratch-to-output scatter for dense LOW_V1 partial final parity blocks while preserving immutable coefficients, exact wire bytes, arbitrary tails, sparse fallback, and no hot-path allocation. Start with pure-AVX2 GF8 P=16 and aligned d=R%P in {4,8,12}, then generalize only if measured.
design: Reuse existing final radix-4 callbacks to write aligned requested terminal groups directly to validated recovery buffers. Keep coefficients in work[0..P) live until every coset consumes them. Retain scratch scatter for ragged d, holes, GF16 padded/ALTMAP, and unsupported backends until separately derived and qualified.
acceptance_criteria: Independent direct systematic generator and forced mature transform match byte-for-byte; source/work guards, unaligned/tail, multi-coset, scalar/AVX2 differential and concurrency gates pass; no partial pointer-array overrun or null SIMD destination; operation counters prove 2*d*B traffic removal; isolated paired timing shows >=5% credible target improvement with no unexplained >2% neighbor regression.
notes: Implemented GF8/AVX2 LOW_V1 P=16 dense final parity-block direct output for d=4,8,12, including same-executable benchmark mode/probe and actual scatter traffic counters. Correctness before checkpoint: strict GCC and Clang direct-encode tests pass (50,075,685 oracle parity symbols; 143 focused partial-output checks); ASan+UBSan+LSan passes with 454,964 KiB peak RSS under a 2 GiB cgroup. Dirty-tree nine-round same-inode ABBA screen found strong promoted cells (e.g. K16/R12/B64 execution 1.1126x CI95 [1.0970,1.1285], public one-shot 1.0983x [1.0869,1.1098]) and no measured regression among weak/stress cells. Final clean-commit evidence still pending.
close_reason: Implemented, independently validated, source-attested, benchmark-qualified, and committed in 03f7962 plus 5309762.

title: Move exact-main immutable input snapshots outside timing
description: Current v10 run_child recomputes the complete source/build/runtime input_snapshot before and after each of 12 smoke launches. Each snapshot pair costs about 69 seconds, expanding a one-cell minimum-sample smoke to roughly 14 minutes. Both otherwise excluded SMT siblings consistently gain exactly one unrelated root/kernel jiffy in that window, so the strict zero-jiffy gate rejects every completed campaign. Design a new evidence version that authenticates immutable inputs once before timing, seals executables, records only cheap per-launch invariants, and recomputes the full snapshot once after timing.
design: Do not weaken or reinterpret retained v10 bundles. Version the raw/manifest/failure/invocation/isolation contract. Preserve sealed executable descriptors, reservation/pair lease checks, strict child environment, source/build equality before/after the campaign, and mutation/relabel tests. The scheduler interval must cover only timed benchmark execution or a rigorously aggregated set of child intervals, not repeated provenance hashing. Compare verifier cost and demonstrate the one-cell smoke completes in a short enough window to make zero-sibling-jiffy meaningful.
acceptance_criteria: Historical v9/v10 replay remains exact; mutation tests reject relabeling and input changes; real pure-AVX2 main/effective-AVX2 Leopard2 builds pass preflight; accepted smoke ABBA and full offline verifier complete with zero sibling non-idle jiffies; timing interval excludes provenance work without excluding any benchmark execution; full runner/planner tests and independent review pass.

title: Extend bounded one-shot direct terminal to legacy-high K8/R4
description: GF8 legacy-high K8/R4 maximum-loss at 64-256 bytes still heap-creates and destroys a full decode plan because the bounded one-shot direct terminal currently requires translated/equal-rounded K>16. Prototype a narrowly validated K<=16/loss<=4 terminal, beginning with K8/R4, using codec-owned generator rows and bounded stack coefficients.
design: Reuse the established direct equations and AVX2 multiply-add callbacks; preserve complete presence, alias, pad, scratch, and failure-atomicity validation. Do not generalize beyond independently measured shapes and do not resurrect the rejected stack-owned full-plan experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Independent direct oracle, exhaustive loss patterns, arbitrary tails/unaligned buffers, alias/failure tests, and scalar/SSSE3 fallback equivalence pass; pinned pure-AVX2 ABBA versus current source and exact main covers K8/R4 plus K/R neighbors at 64/256/1024 bytes; promote only for >=5% credible target gain and no unexplained >2% neighbor regression; focused Release and ASan/UBSan pass.
notes: Completed in commits 64c9893, a8517ae, and f9e2953. Production-linked independent-oracle test exhausts all 70 K8/R4 maximum-loss patterns over 28 byte lengths (1,960 decodes), tails, unaligned/guard buffers, supported aliasing, failure atomicity, zero hot-path allocations, and scalar/SSSE3 fallback. GCC and Clang strict builds pass; Clang ASan+UBSan+LeakSan passes; GF8-only and GF16-only warnings-as-errors builds pass; 10-test production integration gate passes. Frozen 9-round pure-AVX2 ABBA at /tmp/leopard2-k8r4-a8517ae-authoritative-v1 verified 276 accepted processes, matching digests, and target control/candidate speedups 5.985x@64B, 4.165x@256B, 1.782x@1024B, 1.279x@2048B; exact-main/candidate 5.355x, 4.015x, 2.201x, 1.871x. No neighbor failures. Committed evidence: experiments/leopard2/direct_repair/results/k8r4_one_shot_direct_promotion_20260803.json.
close_reason: Promoted after exhaustive correctness, strict/sanitizer gates, and authoritative exact-main ABBA exceeded thresholds.

title: Migrate exact-main ABBA runner to current production provenance
description: The general exact-main ABBA runner cannot authenticate the current production build: pure-AVX2 exact main is unreachable from its CLI, it expects benchmark-attestation v3 instead of current v4, requires promoted selectors OFF, hardcodes an AVX-512 translation unit/count, and misses the duplicate prevalidated benchmark compile entry. Migrate the evidence contract without weakening historical replay.
design: Add v10 raw/manifest/failure schemas while preserving v9 closed-world replay and its failure contract. Bind exact-main native|pure-avx2. Bind an accurately named effective-avx2 production candidate: AVX-512 probes/TU disabled, GFNI TU allowed, AUTO runtime AVX2. Mirror current v4 configuration variables and exact promoted macros (Cauchy log reuse, one-shot equal-rounded, T8 partial/two/ragged, generalized one-loss ON). Make source closure profile-aware. Update plan_balanced_promotion schema compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Mutation tests prove v9 replay and v9/v10 relabel rejection; real current CMake v4 production and pure-AVX2 exact-main preflight pass; current candidate executable is sealed before timing; full verifier succeeds on a smoke ABBA campaign; no performance conclusion is retained from failed/ambiguous preflight.
notes:

Current campaigns require pure-AVX2 exact main and an effective-AVX2 Leopard2 AUTO build with AVX-512 probes/TU absent, bind current promoted selectors/build-attestation v4, and time the public leo2_decode one-shot path directly. title: Unify packed encode terminal validation before further tiny-shard expansion
description: T2, K5/R5, and K5/R4 ordinary packed terminals duplicate scratch, descriptor, packed-slab, and overlap proofs, and ProtectedCount templates emit two bodies per terminal. After landing the isolated K5/R4 result, introduce one data-driven noinline packed-terminal dispatcher with a codec-classified terminal kind, a nullable protected batch range, and a shared branchless dense-slab proof before adding K8/R8. Resolve the current aggregate MakeRange fallback-policy inconsistency explicitly and preserve test-hook ops replacement semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Differential tests prove identical result precedence and failure atomicity for null/sparse/nonpacked/aliased/overflow-adjacent descriptors, scratch overlaps, output metadata overlap, one-shot and one-item batch. T2 ragged-tail scratch behavior remains exact; K5/R4 and K5/R5 parity/counters remain exact; production text size decreases or stays bounded; same-source ABBA shows no target loss above 2 percent. Release, strict GCC/Clang, GF8/GF16-only, and focused ASan+UBSan pass.
notes: 2026-08-02 negative result. Two implementations were evaluated against frozen clean commit 6823618 candidate SHA 6fd5c9ef7c58be667e804616793cfaafe26c285cf2bea562f1959b425561cbe5 on pinned CPU14 under the canonical build/timing lock. (1) Runtime kind/spec-table dispatcher reduced source duplication but regressed protected targets by 18-25% (K2/R2/B64 control/candidate 0.7498; K5/R4/B64 0.8177; K5/R5/B64 0.8295) and was rejected. (2) Compile-time trait hybrid shared public/batch validation, passed focused T2/K5R4/K5R5/high-direct/public/alias/golden tests, retained identical parity digests, and improved T2 approximately 12%; K5 targets were neutral. However 11-round, 50k-reuse ABBA found a credible generic-neighbor regression at K64/R32/B64: control/candidate 0.974323, 95% CI [0.963035,0.985612], exceeding the 2% gate. K5/R4/B64 was neutral at 0.998256 [0.988263,1.008249], K8/R8/B64 neutral 1.006503 [0.994845,1.018161], K2/R2/B64 improved 1.117903 [1.093841,1.141965]. Dirty candidate SHA 4b9cb7a5a9c4ab17b674ac3ad76a18a7d41668978d3e3f7c09f1f88238bf2713; raw results /tmp/leopard2-packed-hybrid-dirty-v2. Rejected and restored because acceptance forbids >2% neighbor loss. Future work should optimize T2 independently without growing/displacing the generic leo2_encode entry.
close_reason: Rejected after two measured designs: runtime unification caused large target regressions; compile-time hybrid preserved targets but credibly regressed K64/R32/B64 by 2.57%, violating the neighboring-regression gate. Evidence retained in issue notes.

title: Eliminate GF8 K100/R28/B64 code-layout regression
description: The final T=2 terminal text-isolation candidate preserves its measured neighbors, but a broad 60-cell AVX2 screen found K=100,R=28,64-byte legacy-high encode at 0.9743x versus the 8cce748 pre-T2 control. Seven-round size-appropriate ABBA confirmed 0.97426x with CI [0.96949,0.97907], narrowly establishing a regression over 2 percent. Clean d994ae7 was 0.98633x with CI [0.97901,0.99371], so roughly 1.2 percentage points are attributable to the final text placement and the rest pre-existed. Attribute transform/public dispatch and I-cache/uop-cache layout without weakening the promoted T=2 cells.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen source-attested ABBA against 8cce748 shows no credible regression over 2 percent at K100/R28/B64, while K2-3/R2 at 64/256/1024 retain >=5 percent exact-main gains and the existing neighbor matrix remains clean. Correctness and sanitizer gates pass; retain negative layout experiments.
notes: Closed at implementation commit 1f2b121 and evidence commit d897d39. Clean-source CPU15 seven-round ABBA at K100/R28/B64: pre-T2 control/candidate time ratio 1.313239 [1.305153,1.321376], a 23.85% candidate time reduction. Exact Leopard main/candidate ratio 0.980622 [0.970844,0.990498], leaving only a 1.98% public-call time gap; clean prevalidated execution is 1.013281x faster than main, attributing the residual to Leopard2 safety validation. Six T2 exact-main cells retain 1.110337x-2.057918x ratios with all lower CI bounds above 1.05. Clean 16-cell same-source neighbor screen has ratios 1.021692x-1.356267x and zero observed losses. Focused Release, GCC/Clang -Werror, Clang ASan+UBSan, GF8-only/GF16-only, legacy golden, batch alias and independent encoder-oracle gates passed. Evidence: experiments/leopard2/gf8_high_encode/results/dense_packed_validation_checkpoint_20260801.json.
close_reason: Promoted dense packed validation, partial-block aggregate zeroing, and isolated prevalidated T2 dispatch. Clean frozen ABBA clears the same-source regression and preserves every T2 exact-main gain; correctness and sanitizer gates pass.

title: Resynchronize Visual Studio graph verifier after promoted CMake option

The first precondition failure cascades into hundreds of misleading mutation-test failures.

title: Extend amortized AVX2 T4 binding beyond 2 KiB with per-shape thresholds
description: The diagnostic batch-prepared T4 callback remained faster than the prior per-stripe path through many 16 KiB cells. Derive deterministic K/R/byte ceilings, retain only cells with credible >=5% same-source gain and no neighboring regression, and preserve exact Leopard1 parity.

title: Bound lab job stdout and stderr growth

title: Select ISA backends from the actual Apple target architectures
description: LEO2_X86_TARGET is derived only from CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR. Apple cross/universal builds use CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES, so x86 host-to-arm64 builds can add x86-only objects/flags to ARM slices and the reverse can omit them.
acceptance_criteria: Single-architecture Apple targets derive backend eligibility from CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES; universal builds use a supported per-architecture strategy or fail with a precise portable fallback instead of injecting invalid flags; synthetic configure/model regressions cover x86_64, arm64 and universal cases without changing non-Apple behavior.

title: Make direct-runner containment self-test race-free
description: The direct-runner self-test waits only for child-started.pid to exist, then parses it before the fixture writer has necessarily flushed content. A reproduced empty read raised ValueError and skipped cleanup, leaving a live coordinator and ResourceWarning.

title: Reject unsafe Unicode and control characters in provenance JSON
description: Strict JSON rejects duplicate/nonfinite/deep/malformed input, but escaped unpaired surrogates and embedded NUL/control characters can reach Path and encoding operations and leak implementation exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: Reject non-scalar Unicode and disallowed control characters in JSON strings, or normalize every downstream path error to BuildProvenanceError. Deterministic surrogate, NUL and control mutations fail closed normal/-O while canonical CMake JSON remains accepted.
notes: Independent audits confirmed remaining unsafe metadata controls: strict JSON/cache paths must reject all Unicode Cc controls including TAB/DEL/C1, line/paragraph separators such as U+2028, and bidi/format controls such as U+202E rather than only ord<0x20/surrogates. Add key/value and unused CMake-cache value regressions normal/-O.

title: Normalize build-root tokens only at pathname boundaries
description: _normalize_build_token performs unconditional substring replacement. Different arguments containing build-root text as a prefix of a longer component can normalize to the same recipe despite distinct semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Replace only exact build-root path components/prefixes ending at a valid pathname boundary; suffix/prefix collision, option-value and adjacent-character mutations remain distinct while canonical build-root-relative recipes compare reproducibly normal/-O.

title: Publish benchmark attestation sidecars atomically and bind one source root
description: The CMake attestation helper uses a deterministic hash temp plus copy_if_different and retains only the first target source_dir globally. Concurrent/symlinked configure paths or a later target from another source root can produce stale/wrong source identity. Use collision-resistant same-dir atomic publication and reject inconsistent source roots.
acceptance_criteria: Symlink/temp collision/concurrent configure and mixed-source target fixtures fail safely or serialize; no-op configure preserves mtime; every target shares the exact bound source root; refresh tests pass.
notes: 2026-07-29 residual audit of current uncommitted CMake helper: the new IS_SYMLINK/REALPATH checks are pathname-only, then file(LOCK), file(WRITE), file(SHA256), file(RENAME), and file(REMOVE) reopen paths. The output directory is not held/owner-only; lock and temporary/destination can be split or substituted after checks; file(RENAME can replace an attacker-created destination. Existing regression covers a static final symlink only. Completion needs an owner-only held/serialized publication primitive (likely an external helper invoked at configure time) or a documented construction that closes intermediate/final ABA and no-replace races, with concurrent adversaries.

title: Contain and time-bound balanced attestation and JSON-regression subprocesses
description: Balanced attestation collection and benchmark JSON regressions use unbounded subprocess.run without new-session descendant cleanup. A hung or detached helper can retain locks/output or stall the gate indefinitely. Use bounded output, timeout, session/subreaper containment and full reaping.
acceptance_criteria: Success/failure/timeout/double-fork setsid adversaries leave no process, pipe or lock; genuine commands pass normal/-O with ResourceWarning fatal.

title: Use stable canonical snapshots for balanced plan and attestation evidence
description: Plan/stage/tree/raw validation follows symlinks and performs stat/hash/read separately, allowing symlink substitution or in-place mutation to produce mixed evidence. Add bounded inode-bound no-follow snapshots and safe atomic publication.

Completion requires componentwise held dirfds and held-root publication/readback, not only final-component O_NOFOLLOW snapshots.

Full embedded self-test passed normal and python -O with ResourceWarning fatal; py_compile/diff-check clean. Keep open for independent audit and consolidated runner gate.

title: Bind reproducible-build proofs to exact compile/archive/link recipes

The proof therefore does not establish its claimed exact build closure.

title: Bind Python find_package calls to exact CMake guards
description: The CMake graph checker allowlists exact versioned Python find_package tokens but does not validate their reachability guards. Wrapping or relocating a call under a false/wrong condition can suppress the structural test itself while still passing the source contract.
acceptance_criteria: The checker records both Python discovery calls exactly once and proves their guards are LEO2_BUILD_TESTS conjoined with the mutually exclusive CMake-version branch; false/wrong option relocation and duplicate/removal mutations fail; normal and optimized project-contract tests pass.

title: Honor Python discovery FOUND state before registering tests
description: On CMake <3.12, FindPythonInterp may leave PYTHON_EXECUTABLE populated even when Python 3.10 was not found. The current code copies that stale path and registers tools with an unsupported interpreter. The modern branch should also explicitly bind assignment to its component FOUND result.
acceptance_criteria: LEO2_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE is cleared before discovery and assigned only when PYTHONINTERP_FOUND or Python3_Interpreter_FOUND is true; unsupported/missing interpreters register no Python tests; supported inventories remain unchanged; normal and optimized project-contract tests plus fresh CMake inventories pass.

acceptance_criteria: Allow only the exact versioned PythonInterp 3.10 QUIET and Python3 3.10 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET commands; reject unversioned/version-drift forms; standalone normal and python -O project-contract suites pass; full GNU Release CTest passes.

title: Gate build-provenance replay CTest to supported hosts
description: The new build-provenance compiler replay CTest is registered with benchmarks disabled and on non-Linux hosts even though the helper/test requires Linux/POSIX descriptor semantics and Python >=3.10 syntax. Older CMake fallback may also select Python 2.
acceptance_criteria: CTest registers only when benchmarks are enabled, the host/runtime primitives are supported, and a verified Python >=3.10 interpreter is available; CUDA and ordinary library-only builds remain optional; configure-inventory tests cover benchmarks off, unsupported host/interpreter, and the supported case.

Independent configure inventories: benchmarks OFF =99 tests with replay absent; benchmarks ON Linux =107 tests with replay present. Provenance audit final tests pending.

title: Normalize oversized integers in exhaustive JSON evidence
description: run_small_direct_exhaustive.decode_json_bytes catches Unicode and JSONDecodeError but not Python 3.12's ValueError for integer strings beyond the configured digit limit, so malformed persisted/shard JSON escapes the runner's EvidenceError domain.

title: Reject ambiguous and type-coerced balanced plan JSON
description: The balanced promotion planner uses ordinary json.load and Python numeric equality in main-document validation. Re-signed plan inputs with duplicate keys or exponent-overflow values are ambiguous, and exact integer controls such as reuse/iterations/warmup accept equal floats (for example reuse=8.0).
acceptance_criteria: All persisted plan JSON is strict UTF-8, duplicate-free and finite; main-document control counts have exact integer types and bounded values; adversarial duplicate, 1e9999, bool/int/float substitutions fail in the planner self-test under normal and python -O while deterministic canonical plans remain unchanged.

2026-07-29 fix staged: load_json now rejects non-UTF8, duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity and exponent-overflow floats; exact-main plan documents require exact integer reuse/iterations/warmup, string mode, and nonempty text identity fields. title: Require exact structural types in persisted all-K benchmark records
description: The all-K validator compares parameters using Python equality, coerces path metadata with int(), and consumes legacy.available by truthiness. JSON booleans, floats, and numeric strings can therefore masquerade as integer or Boolean benchmark schema fields and be persisted as valid-looking cells; parent/padded sizes also are not independently tied to parent_for(K,R). Add exact type/range/equality validation for every consumed structural field and adversarial normal/-O regressions.
notes: Cross-audit scope: canonical (not Python ==) raw stdout/result equality; exact integer parameters; recovered_originals digest must equal original_data; exact parent/padded and coherent path/rule/work-slot/tail geometry; exact legacy.available consistent with --skip-legacy; strict derived summary inputs/all-or-none attribution; canonical manifest cells, completion, and preflight identity comparisons. Adversarial bool/float/numeric-string/wrong-integer cases required under normal and python -O.

title: Keep all-K lock alive across provenance and ISA helper subprocesses
description: The all-K benchmark processes now inherit the canonical lock, but earlier campaign subprocesses still do not: inspect_pure_avx2 launches objdump with only the snapshot fd, and verify_reproducible_candidate_build launches a potentially long configure/build/replay tree through provenance helpers without the lock fd. Coordinator SIGKILL can therefore release the flock while those children continue consuming or replacing build artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory every subprocess launched while the all-K canonical lease is held and ensure each potentially surviving child tree either inherits the exact lock open-file description through exec or is owned by a guardian that retains it until the tree exits. At minimum cover objdump and clean configure/build/replay; do not leak the lock into unrelated post-campaign processes. Real coordinator-SIGKILL tests during a held helper and a nested build child prove a second acquisition remains blocked until the full tree exits; normal failure/timeout paths close it.
notes: Root audit found a second lock-lifetime case: flock inheritance shares the open-file description, so CanonicalBenchmarkLock.__exit__ calling LOCK_UN releases the lease for every inherited duplicate. A helper timeout/error that kills only its direct process can leave build/compiler descendants alive while normal unwinding explicitly unlocks. Final fix/evidence must cover both coordinator SIGKILL and normal timeout/error cleanup (full process-tree containment or no explicit unlock until descendants are gone).

title: Require exact numeric types for all-K benchmark metrics
description: run_allk_gap.metric currently returns float(value), which accepts Boolean values and numeric strings. A benchmark/schema regression such as true or "3.5" at a timing leaf can therefore enter geometric means and speedup conclusions instead of failing closed, despite strict JSON framing.
acceptance_criteria: Metric extraction accepts only exact JSON int/float values (never bool), requires finite positive magnitude before conversion, and reports the full metric path on rejection. Tests mutate every consumed main/current/legacy timing family with booleans, numeric strings, zero, negative, NaN, exponent overflow, and extreme finite ratios; normal and python-O suites reject them while valid integer/float metrics remain accepted.

title: Preserve the exact C compiler in reproducible build replay
description: _reproducible_configure_argv preserves the cached C++ compiler through CXX but does not set CC from CMAKE_C_COMPILER. Candidate provenance accepts an exact alternate C driver for tracked C ABI tests, yet clean replay silently selects the host default C compiler and then fails cache/closure comparison. This makes valid non-default compiler builds unreplayable and violates exact language-driver semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Seed the first clean configure with exact C and C++ drivers using CC and CXX while retaining launcher/arg/target rejection and canonical typed cache entries. A real fixture configured with a distinct valid C compiler path reproduces its C compile entries and validated cache exactly; C/C++ cross-driver, wrapper, compiler-argument, and environment-forgery cases still fail closed. Normal/python-O provenance tests and a clean canonical replay pass.

title: Disassemble sealed all-K snapshots instead of mutable executable paths
description: The all-K runner executes sealed memfd snapshots but calls inspect_pure_avx2 on the mutable resolved source paths after snapshot capture. A same-UID path replacement between capture and objdump can make the recorded ISA inspection describe different bytes than the timed snapshot, then restore before end-of-run identity checks.
acceptance_criteria: Run objdump against the exact sealed descriptor bytes used for execution (with an explicitly inherited descriptor or another immutable, identity-bound artifact), and bind its SHA-256/size to the snapshot record. Add a path-swap regression proving ISA inspection cannot be redirected to replacement bytes and that EVEX in the timed snapshot is rejected even if the mutable path is temporarily restored to an AVX2-only executable. Normal/python-O tests and live snapshot smoke pass.

title: Exercise benchmark schema v6 in production JSON smoke test
description: The benchmark adds --report-direct-executor and schema v6, but the registered production benchmark JSON smoke test neither invokes the flag nor validates selected_direct_executor. Runner unit tests synthesize JSON and cannot detect malformed or omitted production output. Extend the production-linked smoke path and reject malformed v6 metadata.
acceptance_criteria: The built benchmark is invoked with --report-direct-executor in a registered smoke regression; schema v6 and selected_direct_executor are validated against a direct and a non-direct path; malformed/missing metadata is rejected; normal and optimized relevant tests pass.
notes: Independent audit found the new transform smoke used K=5,R=5,L=5, which becomes direct in experiment modes 1/2. Replace with a guaranteed transform shape outside small-direct eligibility (K=17,R=5,L=5) and validate modes 0/1/2 before re-closing.
close_reason: Production-linked schema-v6 smoke now covers direct output-major and guaranteed transform/non-direct cells. Independent audit caught K5 mode1/2 contamination; changed transform cell to K17/R5/L5. Current mode0/1/2 binaries pass the smoke under normal Python and python -O (6/6), and diff check passes; commit will be attached in milestone checkpoint.

title: Remove exhaustive campaign cgroup after real parent death
description: Only the parent finally block removes the campaign cgroup. If the actual main process is SIGKILLed, supervisors remove shard scopes but leave an empty campaign cgroup, and the existing test masks this with harness cleanup. Add guardian/last-supervisor cleanup and a real unmasked parent-death regression.
acceptance_criteria: Actual main SIGKILL leaves no campaign or shard cgroup after bounded cleanup; regression performs no harness masking cleanup before the assertion; normal and python -O suites pass.

title: Prevent FIFO substitution hangs in exhaustive snapshots
description: Exhaustive file_snapshot lstat-checks regular then opens without O_NONBLOCK; a same-UID FIFO swap can block before fstat rejection. Open nonblocking/no-follow and retain exact descriptor/path identity checks, with adversarial regression.

title: Make exhaustive shard resume recover interrupted atomic writes
description: Interrupted or failed atomic JSON publication leaves .tmp-PID files that prepare_output_root rejects forever, contradicting deterministic resume. Safely recognize/validate/remove stale owned regular temp files or isolate staging, and test failed replace plus restart.

title: Enforce small-direct child output bounds during execution
description: ABBA and exhaustive runners redirect child output to regular files and apply size limits only after completion, allowing faulty children to fill disk for the full timeout and across many workers. Enforce bounded streaming or resource/file-size limits while running and add oversized-output regressions.

title: Close authoritative pinned direct-crossover build provenance
description: Pinned direct-encode crossover evidence hashes existing objects/archive/executable but does not prove clean source/object/archive/link closure. A touched executable linked from stale objects can pass. Reuse strict reproducible provenance or fail closed/downgrade pinned evidence, with adversarial regression.

description: Bug hunt reproduced a false fail: path normalization updates nested Ninja graph artifact hashes but leaves mirrored archive/executable link recipe identities stale, so valid normalized multi-config evidence is rejected. Synchronize these identities and add an absolute-path regression.

title: Bind all-K timed snapshot to reproduced executable identity
description: Authoritative all-K gap runner validates one executable then snapshots another without equality binding. A path swap can time different bytes and restore the validated binary before final recapture. Require exact closure/snapshot identity immediately before timing and add an injected-swap regression.

Keep the workload observable long enough for fail-closed runtime sampling and include terminal detail/observation in failure diagnostics; validate isolated and under CPU contention.

title: Preserve one-shot decode scratch bound under plan-dependent tiling
description: Using plan-specific high-rate requested-output rows for L3 tiling made the codec-level query model 2T+R rows, cross the cache threshold, and choose compact tiles while a small-loss 2T+L plan stayed one-pass and required more scratch. Make plan-null policy decisions from the minimum 2T rows while reserving maximum rows, execute the public one-shot wrapper with exactly queried scratch at the crossover, and keep operation-count source/mutation guards synchronized. Validate under Release, ASan/UBSan, strict compilers, reduced fields, and TSan-focused concurrency.

Exact one-shot round-trip at the 32-MiB crossover uses precisely leo2_decode_scratch_size bytes. Release full suite 104/104, ASan+UBSan full 97/97 plus final CPU4/CPU14 focused passes, strict GCC/Clang and reduced-field builds, focused TSan, and decode scratch cross-check 541 checks passed.

title: Make high-pruned stage validation correct for scalar GF16
description: The scalar-only leopard2_high_pruned_stage_test deterministically fails because its GF16 assertion requires syndrome_accumulated_blocks != 0. GF16 fused accumulation is intentionally available only to vector backends; scalar correctly reports materialized IFFT contributions and then VectorXOR, while byte recovery matches.
acceptance_criteria: The assertion verifies the backend-independent semantic invariant without requiring a vector-only counter. The exact scalar Release regression passes all high-pruned cases and existing vector-backend counter/byte tests remain passing. A scalar-only CTest gate prevents recurrence.
notes: Fixed in commit a9e0e3e. Final evidence: GNU13 Release 104/104 twice; Clang18 ASan+UBSan 36/36 with no diagnostics; forced-scalar high-pruned regression 1/1; dual-field portable strict 97/97; GF8-only strict 7/7 and GF16-only strict 7/7 warning-free; git diff --check clean.

A superproject add_subdirectory regression verifies the generated header reports the inner Leopard fixture identity, while standalone, linked-worktree, nested-archive, standard, and all-K cases remain correct.

title: Reject noncanonical CPU sets in lab manifests
description: tools/leopard2_lab.py build_manifest normalizes generated cpu_set values, but validate_manifest accepts externally supplied re-digested CPU lists without element/type, uniqueness, sort, allowed-topology, or capacity checks. A duplicate cpu_set such as [0,0] can make max_threads=2 look valid while scheduling sees one unique CPU; with no active job the pending scheduler loop can spin forever. Booleans/unavailable CPUs are also accepted.
acceptance_criteria: validate_manifest rejects boolean/negative/noninteger/unavailable/duplicate/unsorted CPU sets, requires each set be a subset of signed topology allowed CPUs, and checks max_threads against unique capacity. A re-digested adversarial mutation test covers each case and proves no pending-job busy spin. Generated manifests and normal resume/merge remain unchanged.
notes: Fixed in commit a8881a2. Runtime evidence schemas bumped; adversarial self-tests cover detached and same-session descendants, per-TID affinity escape, incomplete/unsampled observations, unkillable residual quarantine, canonical CPU sets, resume/merge integrity. tools/leopard2_lab.py self-test PASS, benchmark matrix self-test PASS, final Release lab CTest PASS; independent final rereview CLEAN.
